new_roles.title: Director of Quality Assurance
new_roles.description:
**About CAMP Systems:** 
At CAMP Systems, we are the trusted leader in aircraft compliance and health management, proudly serving the global business aviation industry. With over 20,000 aircraft and 33,000 engines supported on our cutting-edge platforms, and partnerships with more than 1,300 maintenance facilities and parts suppliers worldwide, we’re shaping the future of aviation technology. Since our founding in 1968, we’ve grown to a dynamic team of 1,600+ employees across 14 locations globally—all united by a passion for innovation and excellence.

**Our Mission & Vision:** 
We connect the aviation industry through smart technology to make flight safer and more efficient, driving the future of aviation with intelligence and exceptional customer experiences.

**Our Values & Excellence Mindset:** 
We are customer obsessed, trust-driven, owners of our work, stronger together, constantly curious, and boldly innovative.

 

**What You Will Experience in This Role:**

The Director – Quality Assurance drives quality across CAMP's Aircraft Health Management business and provides quality oversight for data and process quality concerns. The role owns the QMS, the internal audit program, and the full quality escape lifecycle, and serves as CAMP's quality voice with OEMs, regulators, and key customers. The right candidate combines deep aviation maintenance knowledge with a disciplined, data-driven approach to compliance and continuous improvement.

This is a high-visibility leadership role reporting to the Vice President, Aviation Health Management Operations. The Director partners with senior leaders across a global organization and will build on an established quality program: strengthening the QMS, deepening OEM and customer confidence, and scaling quality practices as AHM grows.

**Responsibilities:**

**Strategy & Leadership**

* Own and lead quality strategy across the full Aircraft Health Management organization, spanning maintenance tracking and engine health monitoring services, aligned with CAMP's business objectives.
* Serve as the escalation point for quality complaints from customer-facing, maintenance compliance, engine health monitoring, flight scheduling, and inventory functions.
* Partner with senior management and departmental leaders to embed quality methodologies across the organization and lead the associated change management.
* Own the quality budget, resource plan, and tooling (QMS, audit, and corrective action platforms), and build the succession pipeline for the quality team.

**Quality Management System & Certification**

* Own the Quality Management System (QMS) and quality SOPs, driving continuous improvement and ensuring processes meet strict regulatory and OEM requirements.
* Maintain ISO 9001 (or higher) certification for the engine health monitoring business, serving as external certification audit lead and ensuring ongoing audit readiness.
* Lead QMS management review with executive leadership, setting risk-based quality objectives and ensuring consistent QMS implementation (document control, competency records, data integrity) across all AHM locations in North America, Europe, and India.

**Audit & Compliance**

* Own the internal audit program end to end, including audit planning, execution, reporting, and the selection, training, and management of internal auditors.
* Host and manage OEM, customer, and third-party audits, driving findings to timely closure.

**Quality Escapes & Corrective Action**

* Manage all quality escapes from intake through investigation, root cause analysis, corrective and preventive action, and verification of effectiveness, with clear accountability to customers and OEM partners.
* Define and report corrective action performance metrics (e.g., escape rate, time to containment, on-time closure, recurrence) with clear thresholds and escalation paths.

**OEM & Customer Engagement**

* Facilitate and chair weekly, monthly, and quarterly strategic OEM meetings covering quality trends, KPI compliance, and corrective action status.
* Serve as primary quality liaison to OEM partners, regulatory bodies, and high-profile customers and large fleet operators under significant OEM contracts.
* Facilitate weekly, monthly, and quarterly quality reviews with senior management and functional leaders, translating escape, audit, and customer feedback data into trends and strategic quality initiatives.

**Continuous Improvement & Team Leadership**

* Lead process improvement using Lean Six Sigma methods, mentoring teams and driving measurable reductions in escapes, rework, and risk.
* Maintain an executive quality scorecard (customer feedback, escapes, audit results, corrective action performance) to drive data-based decisions.
* Lead, mentor, and develop a team of four, setting priorities and fostering a culture of excellence, accountability, and collaboration.
* Partner with AHM operations, training, and product leaders to ensure analyst competency, training effectiveness, and quality readiness for new products, processes, and teams.

 

**You have:**

* Bachelor's degree in Aerospace, Engineering, Quality Management, or a related field; advanced degree a plus.
* Minimum of 10 years of proven leadership experience in the aviation or aerospace sector, with senior quality assurance experience preferred.
* Strong working knowledge of aviation maintenance and its regulatory requirements (FAA, EASA, and OEM requirements). Hands-on aviation maintenance experience may offset formal credentials.
* Experience managing quality escapes, investigations, root cause analysis, and corrective action programs.
* Experience owning or managing a QMS in a regulated environment, with working knowledge of ISO 9001 (AS9100 familiarity a plus).
* Strong analytical skills, with the ability to turn quality data into executive-level metrics, insights, and recommendations.
* Excellent communication, negotiation, and presentation skills, with the ability to build relationships with OEMs, customers, and leaders at all levels of the organization.
* Strategic thinking with a strong focus on results and the ability to manage complex projects and initiatives.
* Ability to lead across a multi-site, multi-region team; willingness to travel to CAMP offices, OEM, and customer sites as needed.

**Nice to have:**

* Certified ISO 9001 Internal/External Auditor (or equivalent lead auditor certification) with hands-on audit experience.
* Six Sigma Black Belt, with demonstrated process improvement results.
* Quality manager certification (e.g., ASQ CQM) or Certified Quality Auditor (CQA) is a bonus.
* Experience working with large OEM contracts and high-profile customers or large fleet operators.
* Experience in aircraft maintenance tracking, engine trend monitoring, or other SaaS/data-driven service environments.

 

**Why Work at CAMP?**

Join a culture where your ideas matter, your impact is real, and your growth is supported. Be part of a team reimagining the future of aviation.

CAMP is committed to creating a diverse environment and is proud to be an affirmative action and equal opportunity employer – vets/disabled

CAMP is committed to providing access, equal opportunity, and reasonable accommodation for individuals with disabilities in employment, its services, programs, and activities. To request reasonable accommodation, please contact hr@campsystems.com (mailto:hr@campsystems.com).

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, national origin, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status EEO.

Equal Opportunity Employer 
This employer is required to notify all applicants of their rights pursuant to federal employment laws. For further information, please review the Know Your Rights (https://www.eeoc.gov/poster) notice from the Department of Labor.

new_roles.title: Plant Manager
new_roles.description:
If you have what it takes to become part of the Vistra family and would like to start a promising career with a global leader, take a look at the exciting employment opportunities that are currently available and apply online.

**Job Summary**

Overall responsibility for a power plant within the regional fleet. Provide management and direction of safety, environmental and regulatory compliance, operation, maintenance, technical and engineering support, long and short-range planning, O&M Resource Plan, Capital Resource Plan, project management/contractor management, staffing, employee/team development, employee/labor relations, communication and community relations as site/equipment demolition.

**Job Description**

**Key Accountabilities:**

 

* Overall responsibility for all Plant/Multi-Plants within the fleet.
* Ensures generation requirements/goals are efficiently and reliably met.
* Responsible for compliance with safety, environmental, and regulatory requirements.
* Develops/manages Capital and O&M budgets to meet financial objectives.
* Collaborates with applicable internal and external business partners.
* Effectively administers company policies, labor agreements and work rules.
* Provides leadership and direction in the area of Labor Agreement administration including the grievance process and contract negotiations.
* Represents Vistra in legal or community affairs as necessary to support and protect Company interests and to ensure good relations with local governments, school districts, civic groups, law enforcement agencies and the media.

new_roles.title: Plant Manager - Ready Mix Concrete - Solsberry IN
new_roles.description:
About the Opportunity:

Are you a proven leader who thrives on building strong teams and delivering exceptional service? At SRM Concrete, our Plant Managers are the driving force behind our commitment to operational excellence and customer satisfaction. As a Plant Manager, you’ll lead by example—empowering your team, optimizing daily operations, and ensuring every load meets the highest standards of safety, quality, and service.

If you’re passionate about leadership, logistics, and making a positive impact in your community, this is your opportunity to join a company that values integrity, teamwork, and growth.

Your Mission & Key Responsibilities:

* Lead with purpose: Inspire, coach, and develop your plant team to achieve operational excellence and deliver outstanding service to every customer.
* Oversee daily plant operations: Manage staff scheduling, load planning, and route optimization to ensure efficient and timely concrete deliveries.
* Champion customer service: Collaborate with drivers, dispatch, and sales teams to exceed customer expectations and resolve any issues with urgency and care.
* Drive performance: Implement and monitor key metrics to assess plant efficiency, productivity, and service quality.
* Foster a culture of safety: Ensure full compliance with safety regulations and company policies, creating a safe and positive work environment for all.
* Promote teamwork: Conduct regular meetings to review performance, address challenges, and celebrate successes.
* Build relationships: Develop strong connections with customers, suppliers, and SRM team members to support seamless operations.
* Contribute to growth: Participate in strategic planning and budgeting, sharing insights to enhance plant efficiency and profitability.

What Sets You Apart:

* Inspirational leadership style with a passion for developing high-performing teams.
* Commitment to delivering exceptional customer service and building lasting relationships.
* Strong organizational and problem-solving skills; able to prioritize and adapt in a fast-paced environment.
* Deep understanding of logistics, supply chain management, or plant operations—experience in the concrete or construction industry is highly valued.
* Proficiency with dispatch software, Microsoft Office Suite, and a willingness to learn new systems.
* Knowledge of DOT regulations and safety standards for transportation and delivery.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills; you build trust with team members, customers, and partners.
* Dedication to safety, quality, and continuous improvement.
* Willingness to undergo SRM’s pre-employment screenings.

About SRM:

SRM Concrete (Smyrna Ready Mix) is a family-owned, values-driven leader in the ready mix concrete industry. Founded in 1999 with a single plant in Smyrna, Tennessee, we’ve grown to over 600 locations nationwide by focusing on quality, integrity, and service. Our mission is to serve our customers, our communities, and our team members with excellence—every load, every day.Why Join SRM Concrete?

**Why Join SRM Concrete?**

* **Growth & Advancement:** Be part of a rapidly expanding company with real opportunities to grow your career.
* **Impact:** Lead a team that plays a pivotal role in building America’s future.
* **Competitive Pay & Exceptional Benefits:** Low-cost medical, dental, vision, STD, LTD, and life insurance; paid holidays; PTO/vacation; 401k with $100 weekly match; family days; and more!
* **Team Culture:** We value hard work, respect, and teamwork. We support each other, recognize a job well done, and believe in doing what’s right—on the job and in the community. You’ll find a straightforward, dependable environment where every team member matters.

At SRM Concrete, you’re more than a manager—you’re a valued team member helping to build America’s future. If you’re ready to say “YES” to new opportunities and deliver service that sets the standard in our industry, apply today and join the SRM family!

new_roles.title: Director of Operations
new_roles.description:
Penn Aluminum International LLC

As a part of the global industrial organization Marmon Holdings—which is backed by Berkshire Hathaway—you’ll be doing things that matter, leading at every level, and winning a better way. We’re committed to making a positive impact on the world, providing you with diverse learning and working opportunities, and fostering a culture where everyone’s empowered to be their best.

**Location:** Murphysboro, IL (On-Site)

**Who We Are**

Penn Aluminum is part of The Marmon Group, a Berkshire Hathaway Company. The Marmon Group comprises four autonomous companies consisting of 15 diverse, stand-alone business sectors and more than 185 independent manufacturing and service businesses. These businesses operate more than 350 manufacturing, distribution and service facilities, and employ more than 20,000 people worldwide.

Penn Aluminum is a premier manufacturer of aluminum drawn tubing and extruded shapes, providing high quality, engineered solutions to our customers. With strategically located production facilities, we are well positioned to support our customers throughout North America and beyond.

We are seeking a results-driven Director of Operations to lead our aluminum extrusion operations in Murphysboro, IL and Harlingen, TX. Our plants produce precision extruded and drawn tubing and custom profiles for Transportation, HVAC, Electrical, and Consumer Durables markets. Penn is investing over $60M in a state-of-the-art Murphysboro extrusion line that will double our tonnage output and open new markets, and this leader will be central to its success. The ideal candidate combines strong leadership, extrusion expertise, and a proven record of sustaining lean manufacturing across multiple sites.

**What You’ll Do**

* Team Leadership: Develop production managers, supervisors, and front-line employees at both sites, fostering an engaged, collaborative culture.
* Safety & Quality: Champion an uncompromising safety culture, ensure regulatory compliance, and maintain ISO and IATF quality systems and customer satisfaction.
* Multi-Site Operational Leadership: Provide strategic direction and oversight for safe, efficient, cost-effective production at Murphysboro and Harlingen, aligning standards, best practices, and performance metrics across both sites.
* Production Management: Oversee Murphysboro’s four extrusion presses, drawn benches, coil draw lines, cut-to-length, and fabrication, and Harlingen’s 2750T press with draw and heat treat processes.
* Lean & Continuous Improvement: Deploy and sustain lean methodologies (Kaizen, 5S, Value Stream Mapping, Six Sigma) to drive operational excellence.
* Strategic Planning: Partner with the President and executive team on long-term strategy, multi-site capacity planning, capital justification, and budget control.
* Resource Management: Optimize labor, materials, and equipment across both sites to maximize throughput, minimize waste, and improve OEE.
* Expansion Leadership: Lead the commissioning and ramp-up of the new $60M+ Murphysboro extrusion line, preparing people, processes, and supply chain to double tonnage output and grow in new markets

**What You’ll Need**

* Experience: 10+ years of progressive operations management, including at least five in aluminum extrusion; multi-site experience strongly preferred.
* Leadership: Proven ability to manage complex operations and large teams across multiple locations.
* Technical Expertise: Strong knowledge of aluminum metallurgy, extrusion, and downstream operations (drawing, heat treating, cutting, fabrication).
* Lean Acumen: Extensive experience implementing and sustaining lean and continuous improvement. Six Sigma Green Belt strongly preferred.
* Education: Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Business, Operations Management, or a related field preferred.
* Communication: Excellent communication, interpersonal, and problem-solving skills.
* Travel: Regular travel between Murphysboro and Harlingen.

**What You’ll Gain**

* Competitive salaried compensation
* Comprehensive benefits package (medical, dental, vision, and prescription coverage)
* 401(k) with company matching
* Leadership development and career growth opportunities
* The ability to make a direct impact on safety, customer satisfaction, and operational performance
* A collaborative, results-driven work environment

Pay Range:

132,800.00 - 199,200.00

We offer a comprehensive benefits package that may include medical, dental, vision, 401k matching, and more!

Following receipt of a conditional offer of employment, candidates will be required to complete additional job-related screening processes as permitted or required by applicable law.

We are an equal opportunity employer, and all applicants will be considered for employment without attention to their membership in any protected class. If you require any reasonable accommodation to complete your application or any part of the recruiting process, please email your request to careers@marmon.com, and please be sure to include the title and the location of the position for which you are applying.

new_roles.title: MRF Plant Manager
new_roles.description:
MRF Plant Manager

*Emterra Environmental USA | Lansing Material Recovery Facility*

**Location**

Lansing, Michigan

 

**Reports to**

Process Improvement Manager

 

**Employment type**

Full-time, salaried

 

**Compensation**

$90,000 - $100,000 plus 10% discretionary bonus

**About Emterra**
-----------------

Every day, Emterra Environmental USA helps communities recover resources, reduce waste and create a cleaner future. For 15 years we have partnered with Michigan communities, businesses and municipalities to deliver reliable waste and recycling services. What began as Emterra Group's first expansion into the U.S. has grown into a team of 215 employees serving 75 communities across the state.

**The Opportunity**
-------------------

We are looking for an experienced MRF Plant Manager to run day-to-day operations at our Lansing Material Recovery Facility. You will manage and coordinate production, logistics and maintenance, keep the plant compliant with all safety, environmental, labor and corporate requirements, and hold profit and loss (P&L) responsibility for setting and achieving the facility's budget and production targets. You will also play a key role in plant improvements and special projects.

**What You Will Do**
--------------------

* Supervise, coordinate and schedule plant staff and key operational personnel so the facility runs safely and efficiently.
* Optimize the processing of incoming recyclable material shift to shift, based on current intake volumes.
* Maximize daily production and uptime, increase productivity, minimize residue, audit inbound and outbound material, and produce commodities that meet buyer quality specifications.
* Own the plant's internal reporting, including daily bale counts, facility inspections, pre- and post-trip reports, daily MRF statistics and audit reports.
* Understand and monitor the flow of material through the system, and act proactively on suggestions and corrective actions to maximize throughput.
* Maintain maintenance calendars and logbooks for plant and mobile equipment.
* Have mechanical aptitude to ensure the daily trouble shooting and maintenance of the lines and to provide guidance to the maintenance team.
* Develop and manage the facility budget and production targets, and report on cost, throughput and commodity performance.
* Know and comply with all local, state and federal requirements for the facility and its operating permits and registrations, including MIOSHA and OSHA workplace safety standards and Michigan Department of Environment, Great Lakes, and Energy (EGLE) requirements.
* Protect the health and safety of every worker by making all workers aware of known hazards and ensuring they are trained on all applicable equipment, processes and duties.
* Lead plant improvement and special projects, and work closely with Collections, Sales, Maintenance, Safety and Finance teams.

**What You Bring**
------------------

* 5+ years of experience in a Material Recovery Facility (MRF), recycling, manufacturing or production environment, including 5 + years supervising a team production planning experience.
* Strong knowledge of maintaining the processing equipment (conveyors, screens, optical sorters, balers) and the mechanical processes with material flow.
* Working knowledge of MIOSHA/OSHA safety standards, including lockout/tagout, and of environmental compliance for a solid waste or recycling facility.
* Comfortable with data, reporting and Microsoft Office; experience with maintenance or production tracking software.

new_roles.title: Director of Plant Operations
new_roles.description:
**Essential Functions and Responsibilities:**

* Maintain a clean and organized work environment.
* Assure compliance of life safety regulations, based on state specific requirements. This includes staff training, documentation and complete record keeping.
* Routinely inspect the physical plant and provide routine preventative maintenance within recommended routines. Inspections should be documented completion, repairs logged and completed. All repairs should coincide with Fields Senior Living standards.
* Routinely coordinate, direct and document required fire drills and training. Including annual full inspections and inservice with employees.
* Establish and maintain schedule of service of equipment and systems.
* On a routine basis, inspection of resident’s apartments. Ensuring cleanliness and documenting needed repairs. Repairs should be done in a timely manner and communication to nursing team on any unsafe living conditions.
* Maintain outside yard care, whether performed by facility staff or contract service
* Maintain facility to meet all regulatory requirements.
* Turn apartments when move outs occur within 72 hours of move outs. Ensure walk through of apartment is done prior to move out.
* Ordering of all plant operations supplies and products, maintaining budget.
* Oversight of housekeeping services. Leading the housekeeping supervisor and team to success. Ensuring apartments and common areas are cleaned to Fields Senior Living standards.
* Complete work orders within 48 hours of submission. Documented and followed up with resident, staff or family.
* All other duties as assigned.

 

**Additional Functions:**

* Must possess qualities of leadership, tact, and adaptability to change. Must be neat in appearance, pleasant personality, be congenial to fellow team members, residents, families, and the public in general. Must be capable of using own judgement and initiative in daily duties.
* Must have strong organizational skills, as well as the ability to prioritize and meet deadlines.
* Must be detail and team-work oriented.
* Must attend required in-services/ workshops to further education of skills and community requirements.

 

**Qualifications:**

* Must be Drug free and submit to Urinary Analysis Drug screening upon hire and routinely.
* Must be able to pass Criminal Background Check, Health Screening including TB test.
* Must be eighteen (18) years old.
* Have working knowledge of electrical systems, air conditioning systems, heating systems, intercom systems, fire detention systems, plumbing, water and sewage systems, and maintenance of generator.
* Must have good mechanical aptitude and be able to perform general maintenance in electrical, plumbing and carpentry areas.
* Maintain current CPR and First Aid Certification.
* A passion for helping seniors, especially those living with Dementia and Alzheimer’s Disease.
* Experience working with Dementia residents.
* Ability to communicate clearly and effectively, verbally and in writing in standard English.
* Able to work all shifts to ensure staffing coverage when needed.
* **The employee shall be responsible for maintaining the integrity of Fields Senior Living.**

**Physical Demands and Requirements:**

* Maintain ability to lift 50 pounds; to stand or walk throughout the vast majority of the workday; and to frequently push, pull, bend, twist and reach.
* Must be willing to be active and on feet during entire work shift.
* Involves light to heavy physical activity performing non-strenuous and strenuous activities.
* Must have sufficient manual dexterity to work with the fingers and to reach/hand items

new_roles.title: Regional Director, Food Safety and Quality Assurance
new_roles.description:
It's fun to work in a company where people truly BELIEVE in what they're doing!

*We're committed to bringing passion and customer focus to the business.*

**SUMMARY:** The Regional Food Safety and Quality Assurance Director is responsible for ensuring company compliance with appropriate food safety laws and regulations including but not limited to FSIS, HACCP, SSOP and GMP requirements. Additionally, this position is responsible for ensuring company compliance with appropriate customer expectations regarding specifications, quality, procedures, or any special requirement

**ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES** include, but are not limited to, the following:

* Demonstrate proficient knowledge of procedures currently written for monitoring processes on the production floor and ensure proper implementation and enforcement. This includes but is not limited to:
 + HACCP (Hazardous Analysis of Critical Control Points) integration into the facility
 + QA (Quality Assurance) procedures.
 + SSOP (Standard Sanitation Operating Procedures)
 + SOP (Standard Operating Procedures)
 + GMP (Good Manufacturing Practices)
 + Pre-Operation Inspection
 + Bone Elimination
 + Food Defense
* Provide day-to-day leadership for plant management regarding food safety regulations, procedures, and issues.
* Demonstrate a complete understanding of the HACCP, Food Defense and SSOP procedures as well as the regulatory process and supporting documents that are included.
* Possess a complete working knowledge of the Food Safety and Inspection Service (FSIS) regulations, implementing directives and other appropriate food safety guidance material that affects our plant and products.
* Oversee the implementation of any new food safety and/or quality procedures affecting the plant.
* Maintain plant and departmental records, report and log to ensure documentation and design controls are appropriate, and that record retention requirements are met.

**SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES**

This position will have supervisory responsibility.

**EDUCATION and/or EXPERIENCE**

* **Required**
 + Bachelor’s Degree in Food Science or related field or equivalent related experience AND 7+ years of experience in food processing, food safety & quality assurance OR 11+ years of progressively responsible FSQA related experience
 + Excellent interpersonal and communication skills – written and verbal
 + Proficient computer skills, especially in Microsoft applications (Excel, Power Point, Outlook etc.)
 + Working knowledge of Hazard Analysis and Critical Control Points (HACCP) management system required by the Food and Drug Administration (FDA) and the standards set by the Safe Quality Food Institute (SQFI)
* **Preferred**
 + Experience with Food Safety and Inspection Service (FSIS), Food and Drug Administration (FDA) and United States Department of Agriculture (USDA) regulations
 + Hazard Analysis Critical Control Point (HACCP) Certification
 + ServSafe Basic Certification
 + Poultry experience

*George’s is committed to providing reasonable accommodation to, among others, individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans. If you need an accommodation because of a disability to search, apply or interview for a career opportunity with the Company, please send an email to compliance@georgesinc.com or call 479-927-7000 to let us know the nature of your request and your contact information to assist you*

*We are an Equal Opportunity Employer, including Disabled/Veterans*

new_roles.description:
**When you join the growing BILH team, you're not just taking a job, you’re making a difference in people’s lives.**

The Director of Plant Operations is responsible for the leadership and oversight of all facilities-related functions at Lahey Clinic, including the Burlington campus, Lahey Clinic North in Peabody, and multiple offsite buildings. This role manages a multidisciplinary team that includes skilled trades, the Grounds team, and the Safety Department. The Director ensures the safe, reliable, and efficient operation of all building systems and infrastructure, and maintains full compliance with all regulatory and accreditation requirements. This position plays a critical role in supporting the hospital’s mission by ensuring a safe, functional, and responsive environment of care through effective facilities management, infrastructure planning, and team leadership.

**Job Description:**

1. Provide leadership and direction for all skilled trades, including electrical, HVAC, plumbing, carpentry, painting, locksmithing, general maintenance, and grounds operations.

2. Ensure full compliance with all applicable regulations and standards, including Joint Commission, DPH, CMS, OSHA, and NFPA.

3. Oversee facilities operations at Lahey Clinic North and all offsite buildings, ensuring alignment with main campus standards.

4. Lead the development and execution of preventive maintenance programs, capital renewal strategies, and infrastructure planning.

5. Collaborate with hospital leadership, Design & Construction, and Environmental Health & Safety on projects, renovations, and upgrades.

6. Develop and manage annual operating and capital budgets; monitor expenditures and lead cost-effective resource use.

7. Cultivate a high-performing, service-oriented team culture focused on reliability, safety, and continuous improvement.

8. Serve as a key leader in regulatory readiness and response efforts related to physical environment, life safety, and utility systems.

9. Incorporates Lahey Clinic Mission Statement and Goals into daily activities.

10. Complies with all Lahey Health Policies.

11. Complies with behavioral expectations of the department and Lahey Health.

12. Maintains courteous and effective interactions with colleagues and patients.

13. Demonstrates an understanding of the job description, performance expectations, and competency assessment.

14. Demonstrates a commitment toward meeting and exceeding the needs of our customers and consistently adheres to Customer Service standards.

15. Participates in departmental and/or interdepartmental quality improvement activities.

16. Participates in and successfully completes Mandatory Education.

17. Performs all other duties as needed or directed to meet the needs of the department.

**Minimum Qualifications** :

Education:

Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Facilities Management, or related field. Relevant experience may be substituted for the educational requirement.

Licensure, Certification, Registration:

* Certified Healthcare Facility Manager (CHFM) required within 1 year of hire, or when eligible.

Skills, Knowledge & Abilities:

* Strong knowledge of building systems, life safety, and healthcare regulatory requirements

* Exceptional communication, leadership, and problem-solving skills

* Ability to lead teams across multiple sites and manage a 24/7 operation

Experience:

Minimum 7 years of experience in a healthcare organization, with at least 5 years in a facilities management leadership role

$150,000.00 USD – $180,000.00 USD

The pay range listed for this position is the annual base salary range the organization reasonably and in good faith expects to pay for this position at this time. new_roles.title: Senior Manager, Operations
new_roles.description:
We are looking for an experienced **Senior Operations Manager**, based in **Los Lunas**, to plan, direct and coordinate the operations at the facility. You will be responsible for improving performance, productivity, and efficiency through the implementation of effective methods and strategies. It's an exciting time to join the DP World team!

 

**About the Role**
------------------

**How you will contribute**

* Manage the daily activities of a logistics operation to maximize scheduling and delivery of commodities to the customer.
* Interface with customer to ensure smooth -coordination of scheduling and maximization of schedule adherence; provides input on local conditions, identifies needs and receives direction on real-time staffing increases or decreases.
* Enact contingency plans as needed; escalate and direct activities during system problems, disasters, etc.; identify potential problems, troubleshoot, escalate issues to local and senior management, and participate in post-mortem analysis of problems providing input for future process improvements.
* Review ongoing performance results to targets. Take corrective measures with authorization, escalate as needed
* Responsible for providing effective leadership to the Warehouse Managers and/or team, enforcing company standards, act as a role model.
* Other duties as assigned.
 

**Your Key Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in business, engineering, or related field preferred.
* Progressive experience performing professional level operational and plant management duties; preferably in automotive or logistics industry.
* Ability to read, analyze, and interpret complex documents. Ability to respond effectively to sensitive inquiries or complaints. Ability to write documents using original or innovative techniques or style. Ability to make effective and persuasive presentations on controversial or complex topics to top management and customer.
* Ability to define problems, collect data, establish facts, and draw valid conclusions. Ability to interpret an extensive variety of technical instructions in mathematical or diagram form and deal with several abstract and concrete variables.
* Proficient personal computer skills including electronic mail, record keeping, routine database activity, word processing, spreadsheet, graphics, etc.

**Compensation**

DP World offers exciting and challenging roles within a growing international organization. We strive to hire and develop the right people, locally and globally, stimulating personal growth and self-development within an informal atmosphere. We offer a market competitive compensation package.

 

**About DP World**

Trade is the lifeblood of the global economy, creating opportunities and improving the quality of life for people around the world. DP World exists to make the world’s trade flow better, changing what’s possible for the customers and communities we serve globally.

With a dedicated, diverse and professional team of more than 111,000 employees from 159 nationalities, spanning 77 countries on six continents, DP World is pushing trade further and faster towards a seamless supply chain that’s fit for the future.

We’re rapidly transforming and integrating our businesses - Ports and Terminals, Marine Services, Logistics and Technology – and uniting our global infrastructure with local expertise to create stronger, more efficient end-to-end supply chain solutions that can change the way the world trades.

What's more, we're reshaping the future by investing in innovation. From intelligent delivery systems to automated warehouse stacking, we’re at the cutting edge of disruptive technology, pushing the sector towards better ways to trade, minimising disruptions from the factory floor to the customer’s door.

DP World is on a mission to transcend boundaries and bridge the gap between all nations and cultures – not just in what we do but also in how we behave.

We are dedicated to creating a culture where everyone feels respected, supported, and empowered to reach their full potential. We believe that embracing inclusion and diversity, drives innovation and growth and helps us connect people, businesses, and societies. Free minds and different perspectives are changing our world, and together we can change what’s possible.

The DP World family comprises of syncreon, Imperial and P&O.

**WE MAKE TRADE FLOW**

**TO CHANGE WHAT'S POSSIBLE FOR EVERYONE.**

 

**Nearest Major Market:** Albuquerque
 
**Job Segment:** Logistics, Operations Manager, Supply Chain Manager, Supply Chain, Facilities, Operations

new_roles.title: GEUS/PLANT MANAGER
new_roles.description:
**FUNCTION:**

Responsible for the management, operation, maintenance, and performance of GEUS electric generation facilities. Provides technical and administrative leadership to ensure safe, reliable, efficient, and cost-effective plant operations; maintains equipment reliability and ensures applicable compliance obligations are met; develops employees; and ensures adherence to established policies, procedures, and applicable requirements.

 

**PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* Manage the operation, maintenance, and performance of GEUS electric generating facilities together with its associated transmission substations and their interconnections to support safe, reliable, and efficient electric generation.
* Oversee plant and equipment condition, identify deficiencies, coordinate preventative and corrective maintenance activities with the Maintenance Supervisor.
* Assist in development of departmental budget, implement approved budget, monitor expenses, analyze variances and recommend corrective actions.
* Provide leadership, supervision, and performance management for the Production Department, establishing clear expectations and promoting accountability, teamwork, and continuous improvement.
* Oversee the preparation and accuracy of material requisitions, equipment reports, fuel consumption reports, and other operational records required for effective plant management.
* Oversee the development and implementation of work plans, shift schedules, and staffing assignments to ensure adequate coverage and continuity of plant operations.
* Ensure periodic inspections and assessments of generating equipment, transmission substations, radio communications systems, buildings, and associated facilities are performed and deficiencies are addressed.
* Oversee the monthly accounting and reporting of generated energy.
* Ensure compliance with applicable environmental and regulatory compliance requirements, operational and maintenance procedures, processes, and other organizational requirements.
* Maintain a safe, clean, and orderly working environment by reinforcing safe work practices, addressing identified hazards, and promoting a positive safety culture.
* Ensure appropriate physical security measures are maintained to protect plant facilities, equipment, personnel, and other critical assets. Participate in the development and evaluation of cost-benefit analyses, operational improvements, and capital projects to support informed decision-making and responsible use of utility resources. Identify and maintain an appropriate inventory of critical power production parts, evaluate inventory requirements, associated costs.
* Ensure plant operating and maintenance procedures are accurate, complete, current, and appropriate; oversee their development review and revisions as necessary.
* Participate in meetings to enhance compliance, safety, and communication with subordinates and superiors
* Communicate significant operational issues, equipment deficiencies, reliability concerns, regulatory matters, and material changes in work activities in a timely manner.
* Identify opportunities to improve plant reliability, operational efficiency, maintenance practices, and cost effectiveness; recommend and implement approved improvements.
* Perform other related duties as assigned.

 

*This general overview only includes essential functions of the job and does not imply that these are the only duties to be performed by the employee occupying this position. Employees will be required to follow any other job-related instruction and to perform any other job-related duties requested by supervisor or management.*

 

**MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS AND SKILLS:**

* Any combination of education, training, and experience equivalent to an Associate of Applied Science (A.A.S.) or Associate of Science (A.S.) degree in Engineering, Science or Technology or related field, and at least ten (10) years of progressively responsible experience in electric power generating, including at least two (2) years in a supervisory or management capacity. Equivalent training or experience
* Comprehensive knowledge of electric power generation facilities, including steam turbines and reciprocating engine generation systems; associated machinery and equipment; operating and maintenance requirements., and related distribution/ transmission substations and electrical interconnections.
* Considerable knowledge of occupational hazards and applicable safety practices associated with electric power generation, industrial facilities, electrical equipment, and high-voltage systems.
* Knowledge of supervisory principles, employee development, performance management, and training methods, with the ability to plan, assign, coordinate, and evaluate the work of subordinate personnel.
* Working knowledge of applicable environmental laws, regulations, permits, safety requirements, and reporting procedures related to electric power generation, with the ability to ensure compliance with established requirements.
* Ability to communicate effectively, both verbally and in writing, and maintain productive working relationships with utility officials, employees, contractors, regulatory representatives, and the public.
* Ability to evaluate plant operations and maintenance, analyze technical and financial information, identify deficiencies and opportunities for improvement, make sound decisions, and manage departmental resources, including budgets, to support reliability, efficiency, and cost control.

 

**PHYSICAL EFFORT:**

* Moderate physical requirements; must be capable of climbing stairs and ladders

This job posting will close on the closing date shown below. No additional applications will be accepted after the closing date. Applications will not be reviewed until after this posting closes.

new_roles.title: Director of Process Engineering & Continuous Improvement
new_roles.description:
The Director of Process Engineering & Continuous Improvement is the company's technical authority for how meals are made and the owner of its improvement engine. This hands-on leader combines deep manufacturing process engineering with a disciplined continuous improvement approach to make production operations more consistent, efficient, safe, and cost-effective across Mom's Meals.

The role will focus primarily on kitchen and production operations, supporting a highly automated manufacturing environment through process design, equipment performance, root cause problem solving, and structured improvement projects. The position will also support fulfillment operations by identifying automation and process opportunities that improve throughput, labor efficiency, accuracy, and customer service.

The Director partners closely with Production, Fulfillment, Supply Chain, Food Safety and Quality, Maintenance, R&D, IT, and Finance to execute strategic projects and deliver measurable, sustained improvement across the enterprise. This is a player-coach role: the Director is expected to engage directly on the production floor, lead technical problem solving, and develop the engineers and improvement practitioners on the team.

***This position will travel to our other facilities 25-50% at varying times.***

***Ideally, the selected candidate will work out of one of our Production facilities (Ankeny/Grinnell, IA, Oklahoma City, OK, or North Jackson, OH) but are open to remote for the right skills and experience.***

Benefits

Our employees enjoy a generous package of benefits that we are thrilled to provide, and feel is part of what makes us different as an employer. We value our team members, and this is one way we can show it.

Benefits include:

* PTO, holiday pay and holiday of choice

* 401(k) match

* Life insurance

* Short-term disability

* Health, dental and vision insurance

* Maternity/paternity leave

* Health savings account (HSA)

* Flex spending accounts (FSA) – health and dependent

### **Position Responsibilities may include, but not limited to**

Process & Technical Engineering

* Serve as the company's process authority for meal production, owning process design, line layouts, standard work, and process specifications for cooking, chilling, portioning, and packaging
* Lead structured process control plans, risk assessments, and capability studies to reduce variation and improve consistency
* Drive yield, discard, and portion-control improvements through engineering-based solutions
* Partner with Production, Food Safety and Quality, Maintenance and R&D teams to ensure process changes are validated, documented, and sustained on the production floor
* Reduce downtime and defects through root cause analysis and hands-on, engineering-based problem solving
* Evaluate emerging manufacturing technologies and process innovations that improve efficiency, quality, and scalability
* Ensure engineering and process solutions comply with USDA, FDA, food safety, sanitary design, and regulatory requirements

Continuous Improvement & Operational Excellence

* Build and lead a multi-site continuous improvement program, maintaining a prioritized project portfolio with defined savings targets validated with Finance
* Champion Lean Manufacturing, Six Sigma, and structured problem-solving methodologies (such as A3, DMAIC, value stream mapping, changeover reduction, and standard work)
* Drive waste reduction, productivity improvement, and labor optimization initiatives
* Evaluate operational KPIs, including OEE, yield, labor productivity, and discards, and use data analytics to prioritize improvement opportunities
* Coach kitchen and production leaders and engineers in structured problem solving, and ensure improvements are standardized and sustained
* Foster a culture of innovation, accountability, and continuous improvement across operations

Kitchen & Production Engineering

* Lead engineering efforts supporting highly automated meal production operations
* Drive equipment performance, uptime, and Overall Equipment Effectiveness (OEE) improvements
* Identify ideal equipment required to produce Mom's Meals to specification at scale, including equipment that should be replaced or decommissioned and equipment that can deliver OEE improvements and a measurable return on investment
* Partner with Production leadership and Commercialization team to identify bottlenecks and improve throughput
* Lead facility expansion projects, line installations, equipment upgrades, and process redesign initiatives

Capital & Automation Projects

* Develop and manage the engineering capital plan, prioritizing projects by safety, quality, and measurable return
* Lead project prioritization, design, budgeting, vendor selection, implementation, and startup activities
* Ensure projects are completed safely, on time, and within budget
* Manage external engineering firms, contractors, equipment suppliers, and system integrators
* Build a practical, multi-year automation roadmap focused on productivity, yield, and labor efficiency
* Establish project governance, reporting, and post-implementation performance reviews

Maintenance & Reliability Partnership

* Partner with Maintenance leadership on standards for asset management, equipment lifecycle planning, and preventative, predictive, and reliability-centered maintenance practices
* Use maintenance KPIs, including downtime, PM completion rates, equipment failure rates, and maintenance costs, to prioritize engineering and improvement work

Leadership & Team Development

* Provide coaching, mentorship, and technical leadership to process engineering, continuous improvement, and engineering personnel
* Develop future engineering leaders, improvement practitioners, and technical subject matter experts
* Promote a culture focused on safety, engagement, accountability, and operational excellence

### **Required Skills and Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree in engineering or related technical field
* 10+ years of progressive engineering leadership experience within manufacturing, food production, and highly automated operations, including leading process engineering or continuous improvement teams
* Hands-on experience applying Lean and Six Sigma tools, with a demonstrated record of delivering quantified, sustained savings and performance gains
* Strong process engineering skills, including process design, root cause analysis, process capability, statistical analysis, and OEE and yield analytics
* Demonstrated success leading capital projects and automation implementations, including equipment installations and line upgrades
* Working knowledge of industrial automation, controls, packaging systems, and manufacturing technologies
* Knowledge of Sanitary Design Principles and Standards for food manufacturing.
* Experience leading teams in regulated manufacturing environments
* Proven ability to influence cross-functional leaders and drive enterprise-wide change

### **Preferred Skills and Experience**

* Lean Six Sigma Green Belt or Black Belt certification
* Food manufacturing, packaged goods, pharmaceutical, and automated distribution experience
* Experience with Industry 4.0 technologies, predictive maintenance, and digital manufacturing tools
* Experience managing and understanding facility utility controls, including HVAC, water, and steam systems
* Professional Engineer (PE) license or advanced technical degree

### **Physical Requirements**

* Regularly required to use hands to feel, grab, or operate objects, tools, and controls while reaching with hands and arms
* Frequently required to stand, communicate, and listen
* Occasionally required to walk, stoop, kneel or crouch
* Occasionally lift and/or move up to 50 pounds
* Visual perception to perform job including peripheral vision, depth perception, and the ability to adjust focus
* Able to perform repetitive movements
* Able to work in variable temperatures (cold/hot)

**Company Overview**

Mom’s Meals is a home-delivered meal service providing fully prepared, refrigerated meal solutions direct to homes nationwide since 1999. We provide seniors, patients recovering post-discharge and those managing a chronic condition with tailored nutrition solutions to manage their specific needs. If you are passionate about the well-being of others and have a strong sense of community, Mom’s Meals could be the place for you! We are a family operated business looking for fun, compassionate, and friendly people who want to make a difference in the lives of others.

 

**EEO**

Mom’s Meals complies with all applicable federal and state non-discrimination laws. Qualified applicants shall receive consideration for employment without regards to race, religion, national origin, ancestry, color, gender, age, disability, or veteran status.

new_roles.title: Director of Engineering, Global Manufacturing Engineering & NPI
new_roles.description:
The Director of Engineering leads Manufacturing Engineering, Process Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Test Engineering, Test Automation, NPI Engineering, and Customer TPM teams for a global data center rack manufacturing business. This role is responsible for engineering execution at the New Jersey manufacturing campus and for establishing global engineering standards, processes, and best practices across all manufacturing locations.

The Director drives manufacturing readiness, automation, operational excellence, quality, productivity, and successful new product introductions while partnering closely with customers and Platform Engineering. Platform Engineering retains ownership of product design, architecture, DFM approval, and Level 3 technical solutioning.

 

**Key Responsibilities**

**Manufacturing Engineering Leadership**

* Lead Manufacturing Engineering, Test Engineering, Test Automation, NPI Engineering, Industrial Engineering, and Customer TPM organizations.
* Establish and deploy global engineering standards, SOPs, governance, and best practices.
* Develop engineering talent, succession plans, and organizational capability.

**Manufacturing Excellence**

* Own engineering performance for the New Jersey campus and drive global engineering consistency.
* Optimize manufacturing flows, capacity, labor efficiency, throughput, and cycle time.
* Deliver improvements in FPY, RTPY, DPPM, OEE, cost, quality, and delivery performance.
* Drive KPI management systems and operational review rigor.

**Automation & Test Strategy**

* Define and execute factory automation and smart manufacturing roadmaps.
* Lead deployment of robotics, vision systems, automated assembly, digital manufacturing, and Industry 4.0 solutions.
* Own manufacturing test strategy, test automation, diagnostics, traceability, and test system scalability.

**New Product Introduction (NPI)**

* Own manufacturing readiness throughout all NPI phase gates.
* Ensure readiness of processes, tooling, automation, test systems, capacity, and staffing.
* Lead pilot builds, manufacturing validation, launch readiness reviews, and production ramps.
* Identify and mitigate manufacturing risks to schedule, quality, and scalability.

**Customer & Cross-Functional Leadership**

* Lead customer-facing TPM teams and serve as executive engineering interface for strategic customers.
* Partner with Operations, Quality, Supply Chain, Customers, and Platform Engineering to achieve successful product launches.
* Align manufacturing capabilities with customer requirements and growth plans.

**Continuous Improvement**

* Drive Lean Manufacturing, Six Sigma, Root Cause Analysis, CAPA, and SPC methodologies.
* Lead cost reduction, productivity, yield improvement, and waste elimination initiatives.
Build a culture of accountability, standardization, and continuous improvement. 

 

**Ownership & Interfaces**

**This Role Owns**

* Manufacturing Engineering
* Process Engineering
* Industrial Engineering
* Test Engineering
* Test Automation
* Manufacturing readiness
* Factory readiness
* SOPs and engineering standards
* FPY, RTPY, DPPM, productivity, throughput, and operational KPIs
* Manufacturing validation and production ramp execution
Customer TPM organization 

 

**Partner Organizations**

**Platform Engineering**

* Product architecture and design
* Product specifications and BOM ownership
* DFM/DFA approval
* Product validation and qualification
* Design changes and reliability engineering
* Level 3 debugging, root cause analysis, and technical solution development

**Customers**

* Product requirements
* Acceptance criteria
* Product roadmap priorities
* Qualification and approval requirements

**Key Metrics**

* First Pass Yield (FPY)
* Rolled Throughput Yield (RTPY)
* DPPM
* Cost of Poor Quality (COPQ)
* On-Time Delivery (OTD)
* Productivity and labor efficiency
* Manufacturing cycle time
* Automation ROI
* NPI launch success
* Customer satisfaction
Global standards adoption 

 

**Qualifications**

* BS in Engineering required; MS/MBA preferred.
* 15+ years of manufacturing engineering leadership experience.
* Experience leading Manufacturing Engineering, Test Engineering, Automation, and NPI organizations.
* Proven success in high-volume electronics, server, rack integration, or data center manufacturing environments.
* Strong customer-facing leadership skills.
* Demonstrated track record improving FPY, RTPY, quality, productivity, and operational performance.
Lean Six Sigma and global manufacturing experience preferred. 

 

**Ideal Candidate**

A strategic and hands-on engineering leader capable of building a world-class global manufacturing engineering organization that delivers scalable NPI execution, advanced automation, operational excellence, and industry-leading quality for hyperscale and enterprise data center infrastructure products.

**About ZT Systems**
--------------------

At ZT Systems, a Sanmina Company, you’ll get to do work you are proud of alongside smart, passionate people. Every day, there are opportunities to collaborate with the best in the industry to design, build, and deliver impactful solutions to world-class customers. Along the way, you will gain hands-on experience in a fast-paced environment that’s challenging, rewarding, and career-defining.

A culture built around our values we work hard and think fast. We view challenges as opportunities—to do better, push harder, and be faster than we were the day before. When we fail, we learn from it and move on together. And when we succeed, we use the momentum to go even further. We create value with everything we do, building the foundation of today—and transforming the future of tomorrow.

Join ZT Systems and help us build technology infrastructure that connects the world.

**What We Offer** 
At ZT Systems, a Sanmina Company, we believe that investing in our people is key to our continued growth and innovation. When you join our team, you’ll gain access to a comprehensive and inclusive benefits package designed to support your well-being, financial security, and professional development—both now and in the future.

**Compensation & Financial Security**

* Competitive base salary

* Performance-based annual bonus eligibility

* 401(k) retirement savings plan

* Tuition reimbursement for eligible education programs

**Health & Wellness**

* Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage with access to leading providers

-Mental health resources and employee wellness support programs-

* Company-paid life and disability insurance

**Time Away & Work-Life Balance**

* Paid time off (PTO) and company-paid holidays

* Parental leave and family care support programs

**Growth & Purpose**

* Structured training programs and on-the-job learning opportunities

* Matching gifts and volunteer programs to support causes you care about

These benefits are available to eligible employees and are designed to grow with you as your career evolves. Full benefits and eligibility varies by work location.

ZT Group Int’l. is an Equal Opportunity Employer and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any kind. ZT Systems provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws.

Please be aware that certain positions may require the applicant to either 1) be a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful, permanent resident (aka green card holder), (iii) Refugee under 8 U.S.C. § 1157, or (iv) Asylee under 8 U.S.C. § 1158, or 2) be eligible to obtain an export control license or license exception from the Bureau of Industry and Science & U.S. Department of Commerce. All offers of employment will be conditional subject to the foregoing.

new_roles.title: Director, Advanced Manufacturing Engineering
new_roles.description:
Director, Advanced Manufacturing Engineering

White Bear Lake, MN

**About Heraeus**

Making displays foldable? Help hearts beat with micro-particles? Work on solutions involving precious metals? As a family-owned global technology group we help our customers to always being one step ahead.

 

**About Heraeus Medevio**

Heraeus Medevio combines medical technology expertise with collaborative partnerships. Together with medical device manufacturers, we develop and implement solutions for defined applications. As part of the Heraeus Group, we support the professional development of our employees and offer opportunities for career development, depending on the role, location and operational conditions.

To reach our vision of improving 100 million lives every year, we foster a culture of curiosity that thrives on challenge, continuous learning, growth, and the opportunity to try new things. With sites in the United States, European Union, and Asia, and over 2,200 employees worldwide, together, we will meet tomorrow's challenges today.

 
**Position Summary**
 
The Director, Advanced Manufacturing Engineering leads the strategy, execution, and continuous improvement of advanced manufacturing technology across the Americas manufacturing network, including automation, digital manufacturing, and additive manufacturing. This role owns the design, development, validation, implementation, and maintenance of automated manufacturing equipment, assembly systems, robotics, vision inspection technologies, digital manufacturing solutions, and additive manufacturing processes and equipment that support the production of medical devices. The Director, Advanced Manufacturing Engineering role builds and leads a team of engineering professionals across these disciplines, sets technical direction and standards, and partners closely with Manufacturing, Operations, Quality, Regulatory Affairs, R&D, and Supply Chain to advance productivity, quality, regulatory compliance, and operational excellence across multiple sites.
 
**This is an onsite position at the White Bear Lake, MN location with travel to other global manufacturing sites.**
 
**What You’ll Do Every Day:**
 

* Develop and execute the advanced manufacturing engineering roadmap (including automation, digital manufacturing, and additive manufacturing) aligned with business objectives.
* Establish long-term technology strategies to support manufacturing capacity expansion, cost reduction, and product quality improvement across the manufacturing network.
* Identify emerging technologies and evaluate opportunities for implementation, including robotics, AI-enabled inspection systems, Industry 4.0/digital manufacturing applications, advanced controls, and additive manufacturing processes and equipment.
* Lead capital equipment planning and investment strategy across automation, digital manufacturing, and additive manufacturing initiatives.
* Collaborate with Manufacturing, Operations, Quality, Regulatory Affairs, R&D, Supply Chain, and external technology partners to enhance productivity, quality, regulatory compliance, and operational excellence.
* Direct a team responsible for automation engineering, controls engineering, robotics, machine vision, electrical engineering, digital manufacturing/manufacturing systems integration, and additive manufacturing.
* Build and mentor high-performing engineering teams through coaching, performance management, and talent development, while establishing engineering standards, best practices, and design methodologies across advanced manufacturing disciplines.
* Carry out supervisory responsibilities in accordance with company policies and applicable laws, including selection, training and development, assigning work, and performance management of employees.
* Manage complex, multidisciplinary engineering projects from concept through implementation, delivering on time and within budget while meeting technical and quality requirements, and communicate progress and issues clearly to leadership to support project and site objectives.
* Manage external automation, digital manufacturing, and additive manufacturing integrators, contractors, and equipment suppliers.
* Develop and control departmental operating and capital budgets; establish project schedules, resource plans, and cost controls.
* Other duties may be assigned as required.

 
**What We’re Looking For:**
 

* Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical, Electrical, Automation, or Industrial Engineering, Mechatronics, or a related technical field required; Master’s degree in Engineering, MBA, or related discipline preferred.
* Minimum of 10 years of experience in automated manufacturing environments; experience in digital manufacturing and/or additive manufacturing strongly preferred.
* Minimum of 5 years of leadership experience managing engineering teams.
* Experience within medical device, pharmaceutical, biotechnology, or other highly regulated manufacturing industries.
* Proven success leading large-scale automation, digital manufacturing, and/or additive manufacturing projects and capital equipment installations.
* Experience with equipment validation and regulatory compliance in FDA-regulated environments.
* Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional teams across multiple sites and drive continuous improvement and digitalization initiatives.
* Excellent communication, problem-solving, project management, and organizational skills.
* Ability and willingness to travel across the Americas manufacturing network (White Bear Lake, MN; Costa Rica; Puerto Rico), approximately 25-50% of the time.

 
*Medevio is committed to providing competitive total compensation and benefits packages. The expected hiring range for this position is between $160,000 and $190,000 based upon a full-time schedule. This is a good faith estimate on the applicable range. Base salaries are determined by taking a variety of factors in account, including, but not limited to, candidate qualifications, geographic locations, market conditions and internal equity. This position is bonus eligible, with a target bonus of 20%. Our total compensation package includes eligibility for comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage, a 401(k) plan with company match, education reimbursement, paid parental leave and paid time off.*
 

**Curious? Apply now!**

Heraeus is proud to be an employer that provides equal access to opportunities for all its employees. We provide fair and equal consideration to all qualified applicants, regardless of sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, color, religion, national origin, physical or mental disability, protected veteran status, age, or any other legally protected characteristic. A diverse and inclusive culture is at the heart of our Vision, Mission, and Values. We are dedicated to cultivating a workforce that reflects a broad spectrum of cultures, backgrounds, and perspectives.

We participate in E-Verify to confirm employment eligibility after hire. Learn more at www.e-verify.gov

**Any further questions?**

If you need any assistance or have questions, please contact hrdirect-americas@heraeus.com or visit our website at jobs.heraeus.com.

new_roles.title: Manufacturing Engineering Director
new_roles.description:
The Figeac Aero Group has multiple locations across the world. Figeac Aero North America, located in Wichita, Kansas in the heart of the country, is a leading aerospace partner for detailed parts and sub-assemblies with specialization in saturation shot peening, shot peen forming, chemical processing, painting, assembly, non-destructive testing, and machining.

At Figeac Aero North America, we place a high value on our employees. Employees are given the opportunity to be a part of something special while achieving their career goals. We offer competitive compensation as a smaller company in addition to an attractive benefits package for qualified employees.

***Manufacturing Engineering Director***

***Salary****: $90,000 - $120,000*

**Experience:** 8+ years in Manufacturing Engineering discipline in Aerospace environment.

**Job Duties:**

* Responsible for coordinating and executing activities around the following: Leading technical teams in the improvement of current processes, transitioning new statements of work, being the focal point of communication between quality, operations, NC Programming and Planning.
* Monitor and enforce adherence to internal processes and standards to ensure a consistent product to the manufacturing floor.
* Collaborate with NC Programming, operations and Manufacturing Engineering on tool and fixture design.
* Review first part runs with Quality, Operations and NC Programming to verify a conforming part and acceptable manufacturing process.
* Mentoring and training of new Manufacturing Engineers/Planners.
* Interface with customer base to resolve engineering issues.
* Investigate and resolve manufacturing issues related to low profitability or excessive scrap.
* Engagement at the estimating stage on strategic packages to review engineering design and productivity concerns.
* Shop support and guidance on first article builds to ensure engineering compliance and manufacturing process design effectiveness.
* Provides planning, direction, and coordination for all technical activities while monitors performance to estimates, budgets and organization goals.
* Participates in developing organization and department goals and objectives.
* Manage and execute assigned projects to meet all project criteria on time and on budget.
* Transition Technical Phase of new work statements on time and achieve manufacturing targets.
* Be instrumental in reducing overall manufacturing costs of strategic work statements by reducing cycle times, setup, scrap, secondary operations content, raw material content and other process driven cost components.
* Enhance core competencies in complex machining and programming.
* Challenges others to develop as leaders while serving as a role model and mentor.
* Inspire coworkers to attain goals and pursue excellence.
* Recommend and implement process changes in order to improve cost, delivery, quality.
* Identifies opportunities for improvement and makes constructive suggestions for change.
* Analyze information and evaluate results to choose the best solution and solve problems.
* Leadership and Communications.
* Report progress and projects weekly to Leadership Team.
* Mitigate team conflict and communication problems.

**Education/Experience**

* A four-year Engineering degree and 8 years relative experience in an Aerospace Engineering discipline is required
* A minimum of 10 years’ experience in a Manufacturing Engineering discipline is preferred
* Extensive knowledge and experience in machining, inspection, tooling design, assembly, and lean manufacturing methodologies
* Familiarity with MRP systems and fundamentals
* Full knowledge and adherence to ITAR/EAR restrictions and responsibilities

**Required Skills/Abilities:**

* Ability to act with integrity, professionalism and confidentiality
* Mandatory background in an aerospace or manufacturing environment required.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills, including interpersonal, negotiation & conflict resolution.
* Ability to prioritize tasks and to delegate them when appropriate.
* Expert in all Microsoft Office 365 applications and knowledge of ERP programs preferred
* Ability to prioritize tasks and to delegate them when appropriate.
* Self-motivated, innovative, practical, and adaptable
* Ability to speak, read, write, and understand English language
* Must be 18 years or older
* Must be a US citizen or legally authorized to work in the United States, not eligible for VISA sponsorship

**Working Conditions:**

* This position is 100% onsite (Wichita KS)
* Monday to Friday, 8:00 am to 5:00 pm
* Some hours outside of office schedule may be required.
* Regular attendance is mandatory and must follow all work safety programs
* The essential duties job may require the ability to stoop; to reach; to stand, to walk and sit for extended periods of time; to push and/or pull objects weighing up to 30 pounds; to lift and carry objects weighing up to 15 pounds; to use finger dexterity to operate a computer and other office equipment and hand strength to grasp files and other objects; to perceive the attributes of objects by touch; to hear and verbally exchange ideas and information with the public, staff and others on the phone and in the office. Occasionally being on foot, bending, stooping, squatting, kneeling, climb stairs and kneeling and/or crouching to retrieve files and other items. Occasionally Lifting and carrying (with assistance) items weighing 20-50 lbs.

**Competitive Benefits:**

* Medical, Dental & Vision Insurance with competitive rates
* Company paid life & AD&D insurance
* Corporate YMCA memberships
* Paid Time Off
* Generous 401(k) with company match
* Life Insurance, AD&D, Disability & Voluntary options
* Employee Assistance Plan

Figeac Aero North America is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, physical or mental disability, genetic factors, military/veteran status or other characteristics protected by law.
