new_roles.title: Manager/Senior Manager, Global Quality Systems
new_roles.description:
***Who We Are:***

Xenon Pharmaceuticals (NASDAQ:XENE) is a neuroscience-focused biopharmaceutical company dedicated to drug discovery, clinical development, and commercialization of life-changing therapeutics for patients in need. We are looking for great people who thrive in a respectful, collaborative, inclusive, and productive culture to join the Xenon team.

***What We Do:***

We are advancing an exciting product pipeline to address indications with high unmet medical need, including epilepsy, depression and pain. Our Phase 3 azetukalner program represents the most advanced, clinically validated potassium channel modulator in late-stage clinical development for multiple indications. In March 2026, we announced positive topline data from our Phase 3 X-TOLE2 study of azetukalner in focal onset seizures (FOS), and we submitted a New Drug Application to the Food and Drug Administration in the third quarter of 2026. Our Phase 3 epilepsy program also includes a second FOS study, X-TOLE3, which would support regulatory submissions outside the U.S., and the X-ACKT study in primary generalized tonic-clonic seizures, which would support regulatory submissions for an additional epilepsy indication. We also have multiple Phase 3 azetukalner clinical trials underway in major depressive disorder (MDD) and bipolar depression (BPD), based on topline data from our Phase 2 X-NOVA clinical trial. In addition, we are proud of our strong heritage in human genetics, deep understanding of ion channel biology, and expertise in novel chemistries to enable potent, selective ion channel targeting. We continue to advance an early-stage pipeline of novel therapeutic candidates, including Phase 1 studies for XEN1701 and XEN1720 (targeting Nav1.7) and XEN1120 (targeting Kv7), which are being developed for pain. Backed by a strong balance sheet to support our growth plans, we continue to build a fully integrated, premier neuroscience company with strong discovery, clinical development, corporate, and commercial operations.

***About the Role:***

We are seeking a **Manager/Senior Manager, Global Quality Systems,** who will provide leadership and oversight across key Quality Management System (QMS) processes, including quality events, investigations, root cause analysis, CAPA, and change control. This role will serve as a key quality partner across GxP functions, helping to identify systemic issues, strengthen investigation practices, and drive sustainable, risk-based improvements that support compliance, inspection readiness, and operational excellence. The role will work closely with internal teams and external service providers across Xenon’s outsourced operating model to ensure the QMS remains effective, compliant, and inspection ready.

The ideal candidate will bring strong Quality Systems experience, broad GxP knowledge, and sound business judgment, with the ability to effectively challenge investigations, facilitate meaningful root cause analysis, and influence stakeholders across functions. The role will also support quality governance, QMS metrics and trending, change control review, and the continued optimization of electronic quality systems.

This position reports to the Associate Director, Quality Assurance, Systems and will be based out of Boston, MA, USA in our Needham office. This role is a hybrid position, requiring a minimum of two onsite days per week. The level of the position will be commensurate with the candidate’s education and industry experience.

**RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* **Quality Systems & Governance**

 + Manage the oversight, lifecycle management, and continuous improvement of GxP Quality Systems, including quality events, investigations, CAPA, change control, and associated governance processes.
 + Ensure consistent, risk-based practices for investigation, root cause analysis, CAPA, and change management, including review and approval of records and escalation of significant quality or compliance risks.
 + Monitor QMS performance through metrics, trending, CAPA effectiveness, and Quality Management Review reporting to identify systemic risks and drive continuous improvement.
* **Compliance, Inspection Readiness & eQMS**

 + Assess QMS processes and proposed changes for GxP, regulatory, validation, training, documentation, and data integrity considerations, maintaining alignment with applicable regulatory requirements and industry expectations.
 + Support the administration, optimization, validation, upgrades, and continuous improvement of the eQMS and associated procedures, guidance, and training.
 + Support regulatory inspections and internal and external audits, including inspection readiness and responses to observations and findings.
* **Quality Leadership & Cross-Functional Partnership**

 + Provide Quality Systems expertise, guidance, coaching, and training to promote consistent, inspection-ready, and risk-based quality practices across the organization.
 + Partner with GxP functions and external service providers to establish quality expectations, resolve quality issues, implement compliant changes and CAPAs, and drive cross-functional quality improvement initiatives.
 + Promote a strong quality culture through effective stakeholder engagement, sound judgment, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
* **General Responsibilities**

 + Act in accordance with Company policies, including the Code of Business Conduct and Ethics, and ensure applicable policies are understood and followed by direct reports, if any.
 + Other duties as assigned.

**QUALIFICATIONS:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Life Sciences, Health Sciences, Pharmacy, or a related discipline; advanced degree preferred.
* 5–8+ years of relevant experience, or an equivalent combination of education and experience, within the pharmaceutical, biotechnology, medical device, or other regulated industry, with demonstrated experience in Quality Systems, Quality Assurance, or compliance.
* Demonstrated experience with quality event management, including complex investigations, root cause analysis, CAPA, and change control.
* Strong working knowledge of QMS requirements, quality risk management principles, and applicable GxP regulations, including GMP and familiarity with GCP, GVP, and GLP.
* Experience with electronic Quality Management Systems such as Veeva Quality, MasterControl, or equivalent, including supporting system implementation, optimization, or maintenance.
* Experience developing, reviewing, and maintaining quality procedures, SOPs, metrics, and trending to support risk-based decision-making and continuous improvement.
* Experience supporting quality governance activities, regulatory inspections, internal or external audits, and inspection readiness.
* Demonstrated ability to work cross-functionally and influence stakeholders while effectively navigating ambiguity and driving quality initiatives to completion.
* Strong critical thinking and problem-solving skills, with the ability to balance strategic judgment with a hands-on approach to execution.
* Excellent organizational, written, and verbal communication skills.

Our Total Rewards program includes base salary, target bonus, and stock options, as well as a full range of benefits including medical, dental, vision, short-& long-term disability, accidental death & dismemberment, and life insurance programs, Employee Assistance Program, travel insurance, and retirement savings programs with company matching contributions.

Xenon encourages time to rest and re-charge through vacation, personal days, sick days, and an end-of-year company shutdown. Xenon highly values employee development and has an expanding Training, Learning & Development program, including a Tuition Assistance program for advanced degrees.

Compensation Range: $131.3K - $173.3K

new_roles.title: Sr Manager, Quality Planning & Strategy
new_roles.description:
At Gilead, we’re creating a healthier world for all people. For more than 35 years, we’ve tackled diseases such as HIV, viral hepatitis, COVID-19 and cancer – working relentlessly to develop therapies that help improve lives and to ensure access to these therapies across the globe. We continue to fight against the world’s biggest health challenges, and our mission requires collaboration, determination and a relentless drive to make a difference.

Every member of Gilead’s team plays a critical role in the discovery and development of life-changing scientific innovations. Our employees are our greatest asset as we work to achieve our bold ambitions, and we’re looking for the next wave of passionate and ambitious people ready to make a direct impact.

We believe every employee deserves a great leader. People Leaders are the cornerstone to the employee experience at Gilead and Kite. As a people leader now or in the future, you are the key driver in evolving our culture and creating an environment where every employee feels included, developed and empowered to fulfil their aspirations. Join Gilead and help create possible, together.
 
 
**Job Description**

 

Key Responsibilities

 

Global Quality Project & Portfolio Management

* Own and maintain Global Quality project portfolios, ensuring visibility, alignment, and execution across the network.
* Monitor project progress, proactively manage risks and dependencies, and ensure initiatives are delivered on time and within scope.
* Drive end‑to‑end planning and execution of global quality initiatives, including detailed project plans, timelines, milestones, and resource management.
Collaborate closely with Project Leads and Quality Leadership to track progress, manage risks, and communicate outcomes across the organization. 

 

Quality Systems Enablement & Integration

* Capture, prioritize, and manage Quality Systems enhancements and platform integrations, ensuring timely and effective implementation.
* Support the annual Quality Planning process, ensuring alignment with corporate objectives and enterprise priorities.
Develop, organize, and maintain comprehensive QA and QC project documentation, dashboards, and performance reporting. 

 

Governance, Communication & Reporting

* Facilitate regular project updates, steering committee meetings, quality forums, and executive‑level reporting.
* Measure Quality project performance using appropriate systems, tools, and methodologies, including defining and tracking KPIs related to project success, quality impact, and operational outcomes.
Leverage data‑driven insights to inform decision‑making and drive continuous improvement. 

 

Continuous Improvement & Change Enablement

* Perform and assess project and quality risk management, escalating critical risks and mitigation strategies to leadership as needed.
* Identify and implement opportunities for process efficiency, automation, and innovation across Quality initiatives.
Apply Organizational Change Management (OCM) strategies, as appropriate, to support adoption, sustainability, and business readiness. 

 

Stakeholder & Team Leadership

* Manage stakeholder relationships across all phases of the project lifecycle, engaging effectively with global, cross‑functional partners.
* Guide and mentor junior Quality staff, fostering a culture of quality excellence, accountability, and continuous improvement.
Stay current on industry trends, regulatory changes, and best practices to proactively enhance Quality systems and processes. 

 

Knowledge & Skills

* Strong knowledge of Quality Systems, Quality principles, industry standards, and best practices.
* Excellent problem‑solving, analytical, and attention‑to‑detail skills.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present clearly to senior and executive audiences.
* Demonstrated strength in planning, prioritization, and managing multiple initiatives simultaneously.
* Familiarity with project management tools, stakeholder management practices, and performance tracking methodologies.
* Proven ability to engage and influence internal and external stakeholders, facilitate discussions, delegate effectively, and drive accountability.
* Self‑motivated, proactive, highly organized, and results‑oriented with a strong sense of urgency.
* Ability to navigate ambiguity and translate complex initiatives into clear, actionable execution plans.
* Comfortable balancing competing priorities in a fast‑paced environment while fostering a collaborative, trust‑based culture.
PMP and/or Lean Six Sigma Green Belt and/or Lean Six Sigma Black Belt certification is a plus. 

 

Basic Qualifications

* Bachelor’s degree in a science‑related field (e.g., Life Sciences, Engineering, Chemistry, Biology, or related discipline).
* At least 8 years of relevant industry experience in Quality, Quality Systems, Project Management, or regulated environments

OR

Master’s degree in a related field with at least 6 years of relevant industry experience. 

 

Preferred Qualifications

* Advanced degree in a science, engineering, or quality‑related discipline.
* Demonstrated experience managing global Quality projects or portfolios in regulated pharmaceutical, biotech, or medical device environments.
* Experience supporting Quality Systems, QA/QC initiatives, and cross‑functional quality transformations.
* Familiarity with project governance, executive reporting, and KPI‑driven performance management.
Project Management Professional (PMP) and/or Lean Six Sigma Green Belt and/or Lean Six Sigma Black Belt certification 

 
The salary range for this position is: $157,590.00 - $203,940.00. Gilead considers a variety of factors when determining base compensation, including experience, qualifications, and geographic location. These considerations mean actual compensation will vary. This position may also be eligible for a discretionary annual bonus, discretionary stock-based long-term incentives (eligibility may vary based on role), paid time off, and a benefits package. Benefits include company-sponsored medical, dental, vision, and life insurance plans\*.

new_roles.title: Sr. Manager - Operations
new_roles.description:
**Senior Manager of Operations**

**Scottsdale Mint | Casper, Wyoming** 
**Employment Type:** Full-Time | Salaried

**Company Summary**

Founded in 2008, Scottsdale Mint is a U.S.-based precious metals manufacturer recognized globally for its innovation, quality, and American craftsmanship. As a privately held producer of premium gold, silver, and platinum bullion, the company serves sovereign nations, central banks, Fortune 500 companies, industrial clients, and authorized distributors worldwide.

Operating from its advanced manufacturing facility in Casper, Wyoming, Scottsdale Mint specializes in high-purity bullion, legal-tender coin programs, and custom-branded precious metal products. The company combines artistic design, scientific precision, and advanced minting technology to deliver products recognized for their quality, detail, and authenticity.

**Position Summary**

The Senior Manager of Operations is responsible for overseeing the daily performance and overall effectiveness of Scottsdale Mint's Coining, Melting, CNC Machining, and Die Manufacturing departments. This position provides leadership and direction to approximately 30 employees, ensuring manufacturing operations are safe, efficient, productive, and aligned with company objectives.

The successful candidate will be a visible, hands-on leader capable of managing multiple manufacturing functions, developing departmental supervisors, establishing accountability, and improving operational performance while supporting current production requirements and future manufacturing growth.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Manufacturing & Operations Management**

* Oversee daily operations and production performance across Coining, Melting, CNC Machining, and Die Manufacturing.
* Establish departmental priorities, production goals, and performance expectations in coordination with senior management.
* Coordinate labor, equipment, and resources to maximize productivity, throughput, and manufacturing capacity.
* Monitor production schedules and workflow, identifying bottlenecks and implementing solutions to improve output and efficiency.
* Coordinate with Planning & Inventory Control, Fulfillment, Maintenance, Marketing, and other departments to support production requirements and company objectives.
* Develop, monitor, and report on departmental KPIs to optimize workforce utilization and ensure production schedule adherence.

**2. Leadership & Workforce Management**

* Provide leadership, direction, and accountability to departmental supervisors and employees.
* Manage staffing levels, scheduling, attendance, and labor allocation to meet production requirements.
* Establish clear expectations for employee performance, productivity, communication, and workplace conduct.
* Conduct performance reviews, address personnel matters, and establish development objectives for direct reports.
* Develop supervisory capabilities and ensure employees receive appropriate training to perform their responsibilities effectively.
* Foster a professional work environment emphasizing teamwork, accountability, ownership, and employee development.

**3. Safety, Compliance & Operational Excellence**

new_roles.title: Senior Manager, Manufacturing Engineering
new_roles.description:
**Relocation assistance is available for this position.**

**Who We Are**

Stored Energy Systems (SENS) is an award-winning manufacturer of premium quality power conversion products located in Longmont, CO. In business for over 50 years, SENS is the market leader with a proven track record of providing highly reliable battery chargers, DC power systems, and related products to industrial markets. For more information on our company please see our web site at www.sens-usa.com.

**View the SENS Product Catalog**

**Summary**

SENS is seeking a manufacturing engineering leader to help build and scale the organization, processes, and technical capabilities required for our next stage of growth. Supporting the expansion of existing manufacturing operations and establishing new operations at our Broomfield Systems manufacturing factory, this leader will establish the manufacturing engineering strategy, develop a multidisciplinary team, and translate business growth plans into manufacturing capacity and reliable production processes for our fastest-growing products.

This role leads manufacturing engineering, industrialization, tooling, test systems, automation, and technical production support for our systems products, with a strong emphasis on configure-to-order assembly manufacturing. Working closely with Production, Design Engineering, Quality, Safety, and Supply Chain, the Senior Manager will establish clear priorities, strengthen new product and production transfer readiness, and deliver measurable improvements in productivity, quality, cost, and equipment reliability.

A successful candidate will combine organizational leadership with practical technical judgment, building a team that can support daily production while executing the improvements and investments needed to scale.

**Responsibilities**

* Help to build and develop the manufacturing engineering organization. Assess current capabilities, define the team structure and staffing plan, recruit talent, and develop engineers and technical leaders to support SENS’s growth.
* Establish performance measures and execution discipline. Set departmental goals, review project and operational performance, communicate risks and resource needs, and hold the team accountable for measurable improvements in manufacturing readiness, capacity, productivity, and equipment reliability.
* Establish and execute the manufacturing engineering roadmap. Translate business growth, product plans, and production requirements into prioritized initiatives for manufacturing capacity, processes, tooling, test systems, automation, and equipment reliability.
* Lead manufacturing readiness for new products and production transfers. Partner with Design Engineering, Production, Quality, and Planning & Fulfillment to establish readiness criteria and ensure processes, equipment, tooling, test capability, documentation, and training are in place before production release.
* Develop scalable manufacturing processes and standards. Establish consistent methods for process development, validation, work instructions, engineering changes, and production controls across manufacturing locations while accommodating product-specific requirements.
* Expand manufacturing capacity and improve productivity. Lead engineering efforts in capacity analysis, line balancing, factory layout, workflow, cycle-time reduction, and constraint elimination to support production demand and improve labor efficiency.
* Provide reliable technical support to Production. Establish clear support coverage, escalation processes, and problem-solving practices that resolve production issues promptly and prevent recurrence while maintaining progress on strategic projects.
* Guide manufacturing technology development. Lead technical specialists responsible for manufacturing test systems, production software, tooling, and automation. Prioritize investments based on safety, quality, capacity, reliability, and financial return.
* Improve production equipment reliability. Establish equipment ownership, maintenance strategies, critical spare requirements, and preventive and predictive maintenance practices in partnership with Production and technical support teams.
* Manage projects, capital investments, and departmental resources. Develop business cases, budgets, schedules, and resource plans; oversee implementation and production acceptance; and verify that projects deliver their expected operational and financial benefits.
* Partner with Design Engineering on manufacturability. Incorporate manufacturing feedback early in product development and engineering changes to improve assembly, testability, quality, serviceability, and cost.
* Drive safe processes and sustained quality improvement. Partner with EHS and Quality to incorporate risk assessment, error prevention, root cause analysis, and corrective action into manufacturing processes and equipment changes.
* Oversee the development and maintenance of manufacturing processes, work instructions, test procedures, tooling, fixtures, automation systems, and production software solutions.
* Be directly accountable for engineering project delivery, manufacturing readiness, equipment reliability, and validated improvement benefits, while sharing accountability with Production and Quality for labor efficiency and first-pass yield (FPY).

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering or a related technical discipline, or an additional 4 tears of manufacturing engineering experience.
* Eight or more years of experience in manufacturing engineering, production engineering, industrialization, or a related technical manufacturing role.
* Three or more years of experience directly leading engineering or technical teams, including setting priorities, developing employees, allocating resources, and managing performance.
* Demonstrated success improving manufacturing performance, with measurable results in productivity, capacity, quality, cost, or equipment reliability.
* Experience developing and improving manufacturing processes, tooling, fixtures, work instructions, and production controls, including introducing new or revised products into production.
* Ability to lead engineers and technical specialists across manufacturing processes, test systems, automation, and production support, using sound technical judgment to evaluate solutions and resolve issues.
* Practical application of Lean Manufacturing and structured problem-solving methods, including root cause analysis and corrective action.
* Experience leading cross-functional projects with Production, Design Engineering, Quality, Safety, and Supply Chain, balancing daily production needs with longer-term improvement priorities.
* Experience planning and executing manufacturing improvement or capital equipment projects, including defining scope, schedules, resource requirements, and expected business results.
* Strong communication and organizational skills, with the ability to translate business objectives into clear team priorities and communicate progress, risks, and decisions.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in manufacturing of configure-to-order (CTO) and engineered-to-order (ETO) electrical systems such as switchgear, switchboard, etc.
* Experience with manufacturing software development, automated test systems, and data acquisition platforms.
* Experience using ERP systems such as SyteLine for BOM management, item masters, engineering changes, and manufacturing planning.
* Lean Six Sigma Green Belt, Black Belt, or equivalent certification.
* Experience managing departmental budgets and capital equipment projects from business case through production acceptance.

**Location:** Longmont, CO

**Base Compensation:** $120,000 - $175,000 is the projected annual base salary range for this role and will be determined on the candidate’s overall qualifications and experience.

**Bonus:** This position is eligible for an annual bonus based on individual and company performance.

**Closing Date:** December 15th. While we expect to keep the position open through this date, the posting may be extended or closed early based on applicant volume and hiring needs.

**Onsite Perks**

* Free gym with 24/7 access
* Free Electric Vehicle charging
* Breakfast and Lunch Café
* After hours Grab & Go snacks
* Basketball court
* Walking paths

**Benefits**

* Paid Time Off
* Paid holidays
* Medical insurance
* Dental insurance
* Vision insurance
* Short-term and long-term disability
* Life insurance
* 401(k) plan with immediate vesting
* Employee referral program
* Tuition reimbursement
* Professional development

At SENS, our culture is rooted in a set of core values that reflect who we are and how we work. In a recent 2025 poll, our employees identified the values that best define us: *“Innovative”, “Respectful”, “Inviting”, “Flexible”, “Collaborative”, and “Growth Driven”.* Our team describes us as a dynamic, forward-thinking company where everyone has the opportunity to thrive.

We pride ourselves on being an equal opportunity employer, fully dedicated to fostering inclusion and diversity. We welcome all applicants, regardless of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, genetic information, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other legally protected characteristic.

We hope you're interested in making a difference with us. Even if you don't feel that you meet every qualification listed in this job description, we still encourage you to apply.

This role leads manufacturing engineering, industrialization, tooling, test systems, automation, and technical production support for our systems products, with a strong emphasis on configure-to-order assembly manufacturing.

new_roles.title: Senior Manager, Industrial Engineering
new_roles.description:
**Continue to Grow with GXO.**

At GXO, we know our greatest asset is people like you - energetic, innovative people of all experience levels and talents who make GXO a great place to work. Your career matters to us because your passion and excitement will help keep our company moving forward.

 

As the **Senior Manager, Industrial Engineering**, you will lead the development of facility layouts and designs, labor standards, staffing and efficiency analyses, and identify cost-saving opportunities while supporting operational implementations.

**Pay, benefits and more.**

We are eager to attract the best, so we offer competitive compensation and a generous benefits package, including full health insurance (medical, dental and vision), 401(k), life insurance, disability and more.

**What you’ll do on a typical day:**

* Hire, train and develop industrial engineering staff; provide technical support and direction to site industrial engineers and managers
* Develop labor standards, process flow diagrams and job descriptions for new and existing operations
* Conduct time study analyses to estimate facility staffing requirements and establish production standards
* Identify, evaluate and implement productivity improvements
* Document processes to facilitate operational startups and provide on-site support as required
* Convert contract documents and SOWs into work instructions and operating procedures
* Analyze ongoing costs and compare them to prior cost and pricing estimates
* Select appropriate models for receiving, put-away, picking and packing solutions
* Identify storage and picking strategies based on product dimensions and activity levels
* Identify facility design requirements based on activity levels, product envelopes, product flow, transportation methods, building layout and power requirements
* Specify material handling and storage equipment solutions, including automation where justified
* Collaborate with IT resources to develop equipment requirements based on activity levels

**What you need to succeed at GXO:**

At a minimum, you’ll need:

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent related work or military experience
* 5+ years of experience working in a warehouse, distribution or 3PL environment
* Experience with Warehouse Management Systems (WMS)
* Experience with Labor Management Systems (LMS)
* Project management experience, including leading projects from concept through completion
* Experience with Lean Methodology and AutoCAD
* Familiarity with Six Sigma practices and principles

It’d be great if you also have:

* Advanced degree in Industrial Engineering or a related field
* 7 years of industrial engineering experience in a distribution environment
* 2 years of supervisory or management experience
* SQL experience

**We engineer faster, smarter, leaner supply chains.**

GXO is a leading provider of cutting-edge supply chain solutions to the most successful companies in the world. We help our customers manage their goods most efficiently using our technology and services. Our greatest strength is our global team – energetic, innovative people of all experience levels and talents who make GXO a great place to work.

We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity employer including Disabled/Veterans.

GXO adheres to CDC, OSHA and state and local requirements regarding COVID safety. All employees and visitors are expected to comply with GXO policies which are in place to safeguard our employees and customers.

All applicants who receive a conditional offer of employment may be required to take and pass a pre-employment drug test.

The above statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by people assigned to this classification. They are not intended to be construed as an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties and skills required of personnel so classified. All employees may be required to perform duties outside of their normal responsibilities from time to time, as needed. Review GXO's candidate privacy statement here.

new_roles.description:
**Date Posted:**

2026-11-19

**Country:**

United States of America

**Location:**

US-CT-EAST HARTFORD-ETC ~ 400 Main St ~ BLDG ETC

**Position Role Type:**

Onsite

**U.S. Citizen, U.S. Person, or Immigration Status Requirements:**

The ability to obtain and maintain a U.S. government issued security clearance is required. U.S. citizenship is required, as only U.S. citizens are eligible for a security clearance

**Security Clearance Type:**

DoD Clearance: Confidential

**Security Clearance Status:**

Active and existing security clearance required after day 1

At **RTX**, the world's largest aerospace and defense company, 185,000 great minds are united by purpose and inspired to make a difference solving the world’s most complex problems. With our three market leading businesses, world-class operations and investments in research and development, we offer capabilities and opportunity no one else can. Together, we push the boundaries of known science and find new ways to connect and protect our world.

**Pratt & Whitney** is a world leader in the design, manufacture and service of aircraft engines and auxiliary power systems and has been revolutionizing modern flight for over 100 years. Join us and help shape the future of aerospace and defense.

Pratt & Whitney is seeking a Senior Manager, Model-Based Quality Deployment, to lead the deployment and adoption of Model-Based Quality (MBQ) capabilities across the organization. This highly visible leadership role is responsible for driving strategic digital transformation initiatives, accelerating implementation of advanced quality technologies, and developing organizational capabilities that support long-term business objectives.

The successful candidate will provide direct leadership to the Model-Based Quality Deployment Team, with resources aligned to the module center structure including Cold Section, Hot Section, North Berwick, and Supply Chain. This position requires strong leadership, strategic thinking, organizational influence, and cross-functional collaboration to ensure successful deployment and sustainment of Model-Based Quality capabilities across programs, sites, and customers.

**What You Will Do:**

* Lead the Model-Based Quality Deployment Team, providing direct leadership, coaching, mentoring, and performance management.
* Establish operational priorities, deployment strategies, and resource allocation plans to achieve business and organizational objectives.
* Drive enterprise-wide adoption of Model-Based Quality tools, technologies, and processes across engineering, quality, operations, manufacturing, and customer organizations.
* Lead cross-functional collaboration to align stakeholders, resolve barriers, and accelerate execution of strategic deployment initiatives.
* Develop team capabilities through talent development, succession planning, training, and employee engagement activities.
* Monitor deployment progress, performance metrics, and organizational adoption to ensure successful execution and sustainment.
* Champion continuous improvement initiatives that enhance quality performance, operational efficiency, and business outcomes.
* Identify and mitigate risks associated with deployment activities while ensuring alignment with program and customer requirements.
* Serve as a subject matter expert and advocate for Model-Based Quality, supporting enterprise digital transformation objectives.
* Foster a culture of innovation, accountability, collaboration, and customer focus across the organization.

**Qualifications You Must Have:**

* Bachelor's Degree and 10+ years of experience in Quality, Engineering, Manufacturing, Operations, Program Management, or a related field; or an Advanced Degree and 7+ years of relevant experience.
* Experience leading complex cross-functional initiatives, technology deployments, or business transformation activities.
* Strong knowledge of GD&T (ASME Y14.5), 3D model-based engineering practices, and manufacturing quality requirements within an aerospace or highly regulated manufacturing environment.
* Experience developing and executing strategic plans in a manufacturing, quality, or engineering environment.
* Demonstrated leadership experience with direct responsibility for people development, performance management, and team execution.
* Proven ability to lead organizational changes and drive adoption of new technologies and business processes.

**Qualifications We Prefer:**

* Demonstrated expertise in Model-Based Quality, Model-Based Enterprise (MBE), Digital Thread, or related digital transformation initiatives.
* Experience leading teams within aerospace, defense, manufacturing, or highly regulated industries.
* Strong understanding of Pratt & Whitney quality systems, manufacturing processes, and business operations.
* Experience influencing and aligning stakeholders across multiple organizations and levels of leadership.
* Excellent project management, communication, and organizational leadership skills.
* Lean, Six Sigma, or continuous improvement certification.
* Experience supporting strategic initiatives across multiple programs, customers, sites, and supply chain partners.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making capabilities.
* Advanced proficiency with Microsoft Office applications and data-driven performance management tools.

**Learn More & Apply Now!**

Please ensure the role type defined below is appropriate for your needs before applying to this role. **This position is classified as:**

**Onsite**: Employees who are working in Onsite roles will work primarily onsite. This includes all production and maintenance employees, as they are essential to the development of our products.

Candidates will learn more about role type and current site status throughout the recruiting process. For onsite and hybrid roles, commuting to and from the assigned site is the employee’s personal responsibility.

***As part of our commitment to maintaining a secure hiring process, candidates may be asked to attend select steps of the interview process in-person at one of our office locations, regardless of whether the role is designated as on-site, hybrid or remote.***

The salary range for this role is 132,400 USD - 251,600 USD. The salary range provided is a good faith estimate representative of all experience levels. RTX considers several factors when extending an offer, including but not limited to, the role, function and associated responsibilities, a candidate’s work experience, location, education/training, and key skills.Hired applicants may be eligible for benefits, including but not limited to, medical, dental, vision, life insurance, short-term disability, long-term disability, 401(k) match, flexible spending accounts, flexible work schedules, employee assistance program, Employee Scholar Program, parental leave, paid time off, and holidays. Specific benefits are dependent upon the specific business unit as well as whether or not the position is covered by a collective-bargaining agreement.Hired applicants may be eligible for annual short-term and/or long-term incentive compensation programs depending on the level of the position and whether or not it is covered by a collective-bargaining agreement. Payments under these annual programs are not guaranteed and are dependent upon a variety of factors including, but not limited to, individual performance, business unit performance, and/or the company’s performance.This role is a U.S.-based role. If the successful candidate resides in a U.S. territory, the appropriate pay structure and benefits will apply.RTX anticipates the application window closing approximately 40 days from the date the notice was posted. However, factors such as candidate flow and business necessity may require RTX to shorten or extend the application window.

*RTX is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability or veteran status, or any other applicable state or federal protected class. RTX provides affirmative action in employment for qualified Individuals with a Disability and Protected Veterans in compliance with Section 503 of the Rehabilitation Act and the Vietnam Era Veterans’ Readjustment Assistance Act.*

new_roles.title: Senior Manager Infrastructure Engineering and Operations
new_roles.description:
Changing lives. Building Careers.

Joining us is a chance to do important work that creates change and shapes the future of healthcare. Thinking differently is what we do best. To us, change equals opportunity. Every day, our colleagues are challenging what’s possible and making headway to innovate new treatment pathways to advance patient outcomes and set new standards of care.

The Senior Manager, Infrastructure Engineering & Operations leads enterprise infrastructure engineering, platform operations, service delivery, modernization, resilience, and operational process maturity. The role is accountable for reliable, secure, scalable, compliant, and supportable infrastructure services that enable Integra’s business and manufacturing operations.

This position leads infrastructure employees and service providers, establishes platform ownership and operating standards, drives infrastructure projects and modernization initiatives, and partners across Digital Technology, Cybersecurity, Quality, Manufacturing, and business functions to improve service performance, risk management, recovery capabilities, and execution.

### **Key Responsibilities**

Infrastructure Leadership and Platform Ownership

* Lead enterprise infrastructure engineering and operations within a globally aligned operating model.
* Establish ownership, standards, lifecycle requirements, support models, and accountability for compute, cloud, network, identity, storage, backup, recovery, virtualization, monitoring, and automation platforms.
* Ensure infrastructure services are reliable, resilient, secure, scalable, compliant, supportable, and operationally stable.
* Serve as the senior infrastructure subject matter expert and provide guidance on architecture, engineering, operations, reliability, and platform risk.

Service Delivery and Operational Excellence

* Lead incident, problem, change, performance, capacity, and reliability management for infrastructure services.
* Establish service levels, operational metrics, escalation paths, root-cause practices, and sustainable improvement plans.
* Partner with the Service Desk, End User Computing, application teams, and business stakeholders to improve end-to-end service delivery and clarify ownership.
* Promote disciplined operations, documentation, knowledge management, preventive maintenance, and continuous improvement.

Engineering Modernization and Transformation

* Develop and execute infrastructure roadmaps aligned with enterprise architecture, business priorities, cybersecurity requirements, and technology lifecycle needs.
* Lead cloud optimization, platform standardization, automation, infrastructure-as-code, technical-debt reduction, and engineering-led modernization.
* Simplify fragmented or manual processes and establish repeatable practices for intake, prioritization, design, delivery, change, operational transition, and escalation.
* Evaluate technologies and recommend adoption, investment, optimization, standardization, or retirement based on business value, risk, cost, and supportability.

Project and Program Delivery

* Lead infrastructure projects and programs from planning through implementation, stabilization, and transition to operational ownership.
* Establish delivery discipline for scope, milestones, resources, dependencies, risks, decisions, budgets, communications, and measurable outcomes.
* Maintain visibility into infrastructure demand and capacity and provide transparent recommendations for prioritization and sequencing.
* Ensure projects address architecture, security, quality, validation, support, monitoring, documentation, training, and lifecycle requirements, as applicable.

Cross-Functional Leadership

* Connect Infrastructure, Enterprise Architecture, Applications, End User Computing, Service Management, Cybersecurity, Quality, Manufacturing, Procurement, Finance, and business stakeholders to improve planning and execution.
* Clarify roles, responsibilities, handoffs, decision rights, dependencies, and escalation paths across services and projects.
* Facilitate decisions and resolve cross-functional barriers affecting service ownership, project delivery, risk reduction, and operational performance.
* Translate business needs, technology constraints, risks, dependencies, and investment requirements into clear priorities and executable plans.

Cybersecurity Partnership and Operational Accountability

* Partner with Cybersecurity to translate security requirements into infrastructure standards, remediation plans, operational practices, and supporting evidence.
* Maintain clear operational accountability for implementing and operating infrastructure security controls.
* Ensure timely execution of secure configuration, vulnerability remediation, logging, monitoring, identity, recovery, and resilience requirements.
* Provide infrastructure leadership during cybersecurity incidents, including containment, remediation, recovery, evidence preservation, and corrective actions.

Resilience, Recovery, and Lifecycle Risk

* Lead infrastructure backup, recovery, disaster recovery, and technology resilience activities.
* Ensure recovery services and plans are monitored, tested, improved, and aligned with established recovery objectives.
* Identify and manage lifecycle risks, technical debt, capacity constraints, recoverability gaps, and recurring service issues.
* Coordinate corrective actions with Business Continuity, Applications, Cybersecurity, Quality, and business stakeholders.

People, Vendor, and Financial Leadership

* Lead, coach, and develop infrastructure engineering and operations employees through clear goals, accountability, feedback, and development plans.
* Build team capability in cloud technologies, automation, engineering practices, service management, cybersecurity partnership, and resilience.
* Manage vendors, consultants, contractors, and service providers, establishing accountability for service performance, deliverables, costs, and issue resolution.
* Participate in budget planning, forecasting, sourcing, contracting, licensing, resource planning, and investment prioritization.
* Demonstrate Integra’s Purpose, Vision, and Values in daily work and interactions.

### **Required Education and Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field.
* Ten or more years of progressive experience with a bachelor’s degree, or eight or more years with a master’s degree, in infrastructure engineering, infrastructure operations, cloud services, enterprise technology, or a related field.
* Five or more years of experience leading infrastructure teams, technical professionals, service providers, or complex enterprise infrastructure programs.
* Demonstrated success leading infrastructure transformation, modernization, service improvement, or operating-model maturity initiatives.
* Experience managing enterprise compute, network, identity, storage, backup, recovery, cloud, virtualization, monitoring, and automation capabilities.
* Demonstrated ownership of complex infrastructure projects or programs, including scope, resources, dependencies, risk, budget, communications, and operational transition.
* Experience establishing platform ownership, service expectations, metrics, escalation practices, lifecycle management, and continuous improvement.
* Experience managing vendors or managed service providers and holding partners accountable for delivery and service performance.
* Experience leading in a global, matrixed, and regulated environment and influencing teams outside the direct reporting line.

new_roles.title: Senior Manager, Operations - Quality
new_roles.description:
**About the role:**
===================

This is a hands-on role with both strategic and executional scope. You will build and lead quality assurance and quality control standards across Operations, set the sampling, validation, and escalation practices the organization runs on, and partner closely with the Senior Manager, Operations - Payer Ops, the Human-in-the-Loop Operations leader, Product, and Engineering. You will report to the Head of Operations and help define the company's AI/Human QA strategy as Adonis scales.

**What you'll do:**
===================

**Own the Quality Program across Operations**
---------------------------------------------

* Define and own QA/QC standards, sampling methodologies, audit practices, and validation processes across AI agent outputs, human-executed work, and vendor-delivered operations.
* Develop & present quarterly plans and operating metrics; communicate progress and trade-offs; surface risks early + Work closely with the Head of Operations on strategic projects
* Lead quality assurance for payer workflows and agent outcomes, including new payer activations on the voice channel.
* Lead the development and implementation of a near-real-time QA Dashboard to provide visibility into quality, identify performance gaps, and track improvement over time.
* Partner with the operations team and external vendors to ensure work consistently meets Adonis's accuracy, operational, and compliance standards.
* Partner closely with the operations team to align on quality standards, remediation priorities, and operational performance.
* Collaborate with Product, Engineering, vendors, and cross-functional stakeholders to address quality gaps, improve workflows, and support strategic initiatives.
* Serve as the quality subject matter expert across Operations, ensuring quality considerations are incorporated into new workflows, product launches, and operational changes.

**Turn quality findings into operational and product improvements**
-------------------------------------------------------------------

* Translate and present quality trends and findings into actionable recommendations for Product, Engineering, and Operations, driving improvements from identification through implementation and validation.
* Leverage AI, automation, and internal tooling to increase the efficiency, accuracy, and scalability of QA/QC processes.
* Establish quality thresholds and escalation criteria for uncertain, complex, or high-impact outcomes.

**Build and lead a high-performing quality function**
-----------------------------------------------------

* Build and scale the Quality function, establishing clear goals, ownership, processes, and performance metrics.
* Lead, coach, and develop onshore and offshore team members, as the function grows.
* Develop and maintain SOPs, playbooks, training materials, and quality guidelines to support operational consistency and continuous improvement.

**Who you are:**
================

* 6+ years of experience
* Experience in healthcare revenue cycle management (RCM) is required, with practical understanding of payer, claims, or related revenue-cycle workflows.
* Experience building or leading quality assurance, quality control, or quality programs in a technology-enabled operations environment.
* Experience coaching a team and creating clarity across multiple workstreams.
* Experience defining operating standards, evaluating results, investigating failures, and ensuring corrective actions are effective.
* Strong cross-functional communication skills, with the ability to work effectively with Product, Engineering, customer-facing teams, and operational partners.
* Comfort moving between strategic planning and hands-on operational detail in a fast-changing environment.
* An AI-forward mindset and practical experience applying AI, automation, or intelligent tooling to improve quality and operational performance, with sound judgment about when human review is needed.

The base salary range for this position is $140,000 to $180,000. Base pay offered may vary depending on job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. In addition to base salary, we also offer competitive equity and benefits packages.

**About Adonis**
================

Adonis is the leading AI orchestration platform for healthcare revenue cycle management (RCM), purpose-built for healthcare organizations seeking to transform their revenue operations. Traditional RCM processes often struggle with inefficiencies, costing providers up to 15% or more of their potential revenue. Through advanced automation, data science, and AI Agents, Adonis helps revenue teams detect vulnerabilities, optimize workflows, and deploy precise solutions that drive reliable and scalable financial outcomes.

Adonis is headquartered in New York City and has raised over $95M in funding, including a recent $40M Series C round led by Quadrille Capital with continued support from existing investors such as General Catalyst and Bling Capital. This funding supports our mission to restore sanity to RCM and equip provider groups and health systems with AI-driven revenue cycle operations at scale.

**Compensation Philosophy**
===========================

Actual base pay will depend on job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Adonis determines compensation based on each candidate’s experience and qualifications relative to peers, and most new hires fall near the middle of the range. In addition to base salary, you’ll receive meaningful equity and great benefits.

**Perks at Adonis**
===================

* Competitive equity packages
* Employer-paid medical insurance
* Employer-paid dental insurance
* Employer-paid vision insurance
* Employer-funded HSA
* Parental leave
* Commuter benefits
* Office lunches every day
* Office snacks
* Generous PTO
* Located in 3 World Trade Center with easy access to all trains and the PATH, and amazing views of the city

Adonis is proud to be an equal-opportunity employer. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive culture that celebrates authenticity to win as one. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, protected veteran status, citizenship or immigration status, or any other legally protected characteristics.

At Adonis, we fully comply with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA). We are dedicated to embracing challenges and creating an accessible, inclusive workplace for all individuals.

Compensation Range: $140K - $180K

new_roles.title: Senior Manager Operational Area Quality (Hybrid)
new_roles.description:
**Job Description**

**General/Position Summary**

 

The Quality Assurance Senior Operational Manager is recognized as an expert internally in the principles and application of quality assurance and compliance. The Quality Snr Manager will provide QA support of manufacturing operations, analytical laboratory operations and materials management for the external manufacture of Cell & Genetic Therapeutic programs. This role will drive, review & support activities related to product disposition including review of batch data, batch records, deviations, in-process data, EM data, QC release testing and other quality systems documentation.

 

**Key Duties & Responsibilities**

* Responsible for quality support of Vertex Cell and Gene Therapy manufacturing operations across all phases of development, support of analytical laboratory, materials management and manufacturing operations.

* Responsible for GMP batch disposition activities including review and approval of batch records, deviations, in-process data, EM data, QC release testing, materials review board and other quality activities as applicable to determine acceptability of product disposition.

* Partner with External CDMOs

* Provide QA support of change controls, process and OOS investigations, and associated CAPAs.

* Responsible for approval of COAs and product labelling.

* Support review and approval of manufacturing documents such as technical and analytical protocols/reports

* Support technical transfer, and process performance qualification activities.

* Responsible for identifying compliance risks and gaps for GMP processes and supporting implementation of mitigating controls

* Support audit and inspection readiness activities.

* Act as a trusted advisor by providing compliance guidance through collaborative review and partnering with business stakeholders and contract manufacturers.

* Support the vendor management process including the creation and review of Quality Agreements with suppliers.

* Assist with addressing product complaints

* Maintain periodic batch record metrics and assists department with routine/quarterly Quality System data review metrics and reporting

* Execute improvements to QA operations procedure.

* Participate/ lead Cell & Genetic Program and Quality projects and drive continuous improvement activities.

 

**Required Education Level**

* Bachelor's degree in a biotech/ Lifesciences field.

* Preferred Master's degree or relevant comparable background.

 

**Required Experience**

8+ years of relevant industry experience such as manufacturing, quality assurance, and/or quality control in biotechnology/regulated pharmaceutical environment.

 

**Required Knowledge/Skills**

* Demonstrated experience providing QA support to GMP manufacturing operation
* Experience successfully leading event investigations, Root Cause Analysis and CAPA
* Experience with network-based applications such as Oracle, TrackWise, Veeva
* In-depth knowledge of both the conceptual and practical application of cGMPs in a pharmaceutical setting; Biotech/Cell & Gene GMP regulations and applicability. (e.g. EU, FDA, ICH, USP, etc. or other industry best practices ex. ISPE, WHO, etc.)
* Knowledge in Cell technology, aseptic manufacturing technology, analytical assays, cell & genetic therapies/Biologics processing, fill/finish and testing.
* Professional membership or equivalent in relevant societies, network of knowledge in cell and gene therapy industry.
* Ability to evaluate quality matters and make decisions utilizing risk-based approach
Ability to independently lead cross-functional teams, and effectively communicate with business stakeholders. 

 

**Other Requirements**

Up to 15% Travel may be required 

 
 

At Vertex, we embrace continuous learning and encourage employees to stay informed on advances in AI, technology, automation, and industry trends. We seek talent who bring an external perspective, demonstrate curiosity and sound judgment, and thoughtfully adopt new capabilities that improve decision-making, drive innovation, increase efficiency, and help deliver better outcomes for patients.

**Pay Range:**

$133,800 - $200,600

**Disclosure Statement:**

The range provided is based on what we believe is a reasonable estimate for the base salary pay range for this job at the time of posting. This role is eligible for an annual bonus and annual equity awards. Some roles may also be eligible for overtime pay, in accordance with federal and state requirements. Actual base salary pay will be based on a number of factors, including skills, competencies, experience, and other job-related factors permitted by law.

At Vertex, our Total Rewards offerings also include inclusive market-leading benefits to meet our employees wherever they are in their career, financial, family and wellbeing journey while providing flexibility and resources to support their growth and aspirations. From medical, dental and vision benefits to generous paid time off (including a week-long company shutdown in the Summer and the Winter), educational assistance programs including student loan repayment, a generous commuting subsidy, matching charitable donations, 401(k) and so much more.

**Flex Designation:**

Hybrid-Eligible Or On-Site Eligible

**Flex Eligibility Status:**

In this Hybrid-Eligible role, you can choose to be designated as:

new_roles.title: Senior Manager, Quality, Fauna
new_roles.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Fauna Robotics is building capable, safe, and delightful robots for everyday life. We are hiring a Senior Manager to lead the quality, test engineering, and reliability organization supporting our robots from development through production. 
In this role, you will improve product and manufacturing quality while building the testing capabilities needed to scale. Your organization will support new product introduction through volume production across our facilities, suppliers, and manufacturing partners. 
You will build the team and its engineering leadership, set the technical direction, and establish quality standards and validation processes. You will turn changing product and manufacturing needs into a roadmap that supports higher production volumes and additional sites. 
The ideal candidate is a technically strong engineering leader who has improved quality and reliability for products where hardware and software must work together. They can evaluate test strategies and guide critical supplier, production, and reliability investigations. They grow engineers and leaders, and make clear decisions on scope and priority while product designs and manufacturing processes are changing. 
 
Key job responsibilities 

* Architect the quality, test engineering, and reliability organization. Assess capability gaps, define the staffing and investment plan, and hire and develop the engineering leaders and teams needed to scale.
* Establish supplier and factory quality teams, with Fauna engineers embedded at manufacturing sites. Strengthen and scale the quality system to support new products and increasing production volumes.
* Define and lead the reliability strategy, working with our engineers to improve robot performance and durability.
* Build and scale reliability labs and test infrastructure to support product development and production growth.
* Scale and develop the manufacturing test engineering team, shaping its structure, growing its leaders, and strengthening its capabilities to support new products and increasing production volumes.
* Deploy and qualify production test systems across our facilities and manufacturing partners. Partner with the software and systems team on automation and traceable results, and improve repeatability, cycle time, and failure diagnosis.
* Partner with engineering and operations to embed quality, reliability, and testability into product design and production readiness.
* Establish quality and reliability metrics and use production, test, and field data to guide priorities and drive sustained improvement.

 
About the team 
Fauna Robotics, an Amazon company, is building capable, safe, and genuinely delightful robots for everyday life. Our goal is simple: make robots people actually want to live and interact with in everyday human spaces.
 
We believe that future won’t arrive until building for robotics becomes far more accessible. Today, too much effort is spent reinventing the fundamentals. We’re changing that by developing tightly integrated hardware and software systems that make it faster, safer, and more intuitive to create real-world robotic products.
 
Our work spans the full stack: mechanical design, control systems, dynamic modeling, and intelligent software. The focus is not just functionality, but experience. We’re building robots that feel responsive, expressive, and genuinely useful.
 
At Fauna, you’ll work at the frontier of this space, helping define how robots move, manipulate, and interact with people in natural environments. It’s an opportunity to solve hard problems across hardware and software with a team focused on making robotics accessible and joyful to build.
 
If you care about making robotics real for everyone and building systems that are as delightful as they are capable, we’re interested in hearing from you

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* Bachelor's degree in Mechanical or Electrical Engineering or a related field
* 10+ years in quality, test engineering, or reliability for complex electromechanical products.
* 5+ years managing multidisciplinary engineering teams, with a track record of building organizations and developing engineers and leaders.
* Experience scaling supplier and manufacturing quality through NPI and production ramp, with strong knowledge of quality systems.
* Technical depth in reliability and manufacturing test engineering, with experience scaling test programs and infrastructure for integrated hardware-software products.
* Strong command of statistical analysis and structured problem-solving, with demonstrated success turning engineering data into product and process improvements.

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Experience with robotics or autonomous systems.
* Experience leading engineering managers or distributed teams across multiple manufacturing sites.
* Experience working with contract manufacturers and suppliers globally
* Experience with product safety certification or formal quality management standards.

 
Amazon is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of protected veteran status, disability, or other legally protected status. 
 
Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

The base salary range for this position is listed below. Your Amazon package will include sign-on payments and restricted stock units (RSUs). Final compensation will be determined based on factors including experience, qualifications, and location. Amazon also offers comprehensive benefits including health insurance (medical, dental, vision, prescription, Basic Life & AD&D insurance and option for Supplemental life plans, EAP, Mental Health Support, Medical Advice Line, Flexible Spending Accounts, Adoption and Surrogacy Reimbursement coverage), 401(k) matching, paid time off, and parental leave. Learn more about our benefits at https://amazon.jobs/en/benefits.

new_roles.title: Senior Manager, Manufacturing Quality
new_roles.description:
At GE Appliances, a Haier company, we come together to make “good things, for life.” As the fastest-growing appliance company in the U.S., we’re powered by creators, thinkers and makers who believe that anything is possible and that there’s always a better way. We believe in the power of our people and in giving them the freedom to explore, discover and build good things, together.

 

The GE Appliances philosophy, backed by three simple commitments defines the way we work, invent, create, do business, and serve our communities: *we come together*, *we always look for a better way*, and *we create possibilities*.

Candidates must be legally authorized to work in the United States at the time of hire and must be able to maintain such authorization without current or future employer or school sponsorship. GE Appliances will not sponsor employment-based visas for this position now or in the future.

Interested in joining us on our journey?

 
The Senior Manager, Manufacturing Quality leads a team supporting the execution of short-term and long term projects focused on product and process quality improvement. The role supports front-line leadership and development of both salary and hourly team members in support of the factory Manufacturing Control Plans. The role is responsible for working cross-functionally to execute the overall goal for reducing the cost of poor quality associated with plant operations and product performance post-sale.

**Position**
------------

Senior Manager, Manufacturing Quality

**Location**
------------

USA, Louisville, KY

**How You'll Create Possibilities**
-----------------------------------

* Live, promote and support the Appliance Production System (APS) philosophy and drive continuous improvement in the quality and adjacent areas. Coach all team members to ensure cross-functional, focused collaboration is the way we work.
* Partner with the Quality Improvement Engineering, Business Operations and Manufacturing Engineering Leaders to promote a culture that establishes, sustains and improves product quality through engineering problem solving and discipline around supporting systems. Promote a method-based quick response to new issues.
* Responsible for developing and tracking team performance metrics tied to the overall factory (FPY, EOLA, Scrap) and effect to the product line financial plan (Damage, Scrap). Leads the team to complete projects and tasks supporting this effort. Owns and assigns tasks and establishes accountability at the appropriate level.
* Closely collaborates with the product line Engineering, Field Quality and Service organizations to understand and respond to part or system product level performance issues impacting owner use and satisfaction. Responds to this data in addition to internal data streams (leading indicators) for product quality and reliability (Engineering, EOLA and audit labs).
* Identify and execute projects to improve the cost of operations. Serve as a broad owner for Corrective and Preventative Actions (CAPA), Corrective Action Request (CAR) approach to problem solving.
* Owner of the execution of attributes of the Manufacturing Control Plan for broad areas. Responsible for the training, execution, auditing and improvement of the Manufacturing Quality Control Plan. Support efforts intended to improve workstation documentation process; create, update and maintain Manufacturing Control Instructions (MCI’s), visual aid and alerts (single point lessons) as needed.
* Strong technical aptitude and ability to coach others in complex engineering topics like dimensional control, material properties, failure analysis as well as emerging technologies such as AI
* Support analysis of data as part of Statistical Process Control (SPC) and implementation of responses as required by MCI/MCP. Escalate and measure response to data trends. Validate root cause response for effectiveness.
* Lead and support 1x1 problem solving for quality systems and related issues collaborate cross functionally to improve product quality through the identification and elimination of root cause of issues. Focus on overall repair efficiency.

**What You'll Bring to Our Team**
---------------------------------

* 8+ Years of successful experience in Manufacturing / Quality, focused on providing operational support to support operations and vertical manufacturing operations.
* Demonstrated expertise in a combination of Metrology, CMM or 3D scanning of complicated assemblies
* Ability to work within large cross-functional teams and at multiple levels in the organization.
* Demonstrated excellent communication, presentation, and facilitation skills.
* Demonstrated experience as a hands-on problem solver including complex systems (supply, build, testing and diagnosis)
* Demonstrated leadership during technically challenging and complicated cross functional projects/tasks

**Desired Characteristics**

* Engineering degree with strong content tied to understanding and impact to business financial performance
* Quality Leadership experience
* Prior experience in a union environment
* Strong organizational skills- focused on project and resource management

### **Working Conditions**

### 

* Working conditions are normal for a high-volume manufacturing environment.
* Working in this environment will occasionally require the use of safety equipment to include but not limited to: eye safety glasses, hearing protectors, work boots, and hardhats.
* These roles require frequent walking in a manufacturing plant environment.
* Travel (up to 10%) to suppliers and other manufacturing locations as needed.
* This position will be located in Louisville, KY.
* Hours & Weekends: Working off-shift and weekends may be required.

**Our Culture**
---------------

Our work is centered on our People and Culture as reflected in our Zero Distance philosophy and we recognize the importance of reaffirming our commitment to inclusion and diversity (I&D). This underscores our commitment to fostering an environment where every individual feels valued, connected, and empowered to contribute, while positioning our organization to adapt seamlessly to the evolving needs of our workforce and communities. 
 
This reflects our dedication to creating solutions that: Empower colleagues by fostering an environment where all voices are heard, valued, and encouraged to contribute. Strengthen communities where we live and work. Reinforce a culture of belonging, purpose, and engagement. Reflect the diversity of the communities we serve through our workforce, products, and practices. 
 
By further embedding Zero Distance into our People and Culture framework, we will continue to build a deeply connected organization. We are cultivating a culture of engagement, belonging, and connection, because while attracting new talent remains a priority, retention is a cornerstone of our strategy.

GE Appliances is a trust-based organization. It is important we offer our employees the flexibility they need to do their best work while balancing the needs of the business and individuals. When you join GE Appliances, you will have the opportunity to work with your leader to create a flexible work arrangement that balances the needs of the individual, team, and organization.

GE Appliances is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, national or ethnic origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, disability, protected veteran status or other characteristics protected by law.

GE Appliances participates in E-Verify and will provide the federal government with your Form I-9 information to confirm that you are authorized to work in the U.S

new_roles.title: Senior Manager Quality
new_roles.description:
**We believe that great healthcare is an essential safeguard of human dignity.**

At Laborie, we know the work we do matters – it’s what fuels our motivation and contributes to our success. If you’re ready to make a positive impact in the lives of patients across the globe, we’d like to meet you.

We support and empower our employees to grow their careers in an environment that encourages a sense of belonging and a connection to doing good. We’re not afraid to roll up our sleeves to make our goals a reality and work together to solve for our customers. We reward and recognize our employees based on our values of **Aspire to Greatness, Respect All, Own It, Working Together, Persist with Passion.**

**Who We’re Looking For:**

To ensure compliance with applicable laws, regulations, and the Laborie Medical Quality Systems in the development, manufacturing, and marketing of Laborie Medical products. The position supports corporate wide process improvement initiatives relating to Quality and Regulatory.

**About the Role:**

* Develop and direct quality strategies, objectives, policies and procedures for assigned sites and Quality Management Systems.
* Directly responsible for the CAPA, Internal Audit, Complaint Handling and Training Systems for assigned sites and Quality Management Systems, including results against Quality Objectives related to these areas.
* Provide team leadership, development, and talent management activities including coaching, resource forecasting, hiring, performance management, training, and budgeting for the Quality Assurance and Quality Engineering functions to meet the company's objectives.
* Maintain quality standards set forth in the Laborie Medical Quality Manual(s) and those of its subsidiaries.
* Influence management and staff to encourage continuous improvement of quality and compliance.
* Proactively identify/resolve compliance risks.
* Fulfill the duties of back-up Management Representative.
* Play prominent role in acquisition due diligence and integration efforts.
* Prioritize and manage continuous improvement activities for Laborie
* Provide technical recommendations based on trend analysis to eliminate future problems and execute changes as necessary.
* Maintain compliance to all applicable regulations for the marketing of medical devices.
* Manage the CAPA process for all the company QMS’s.
* Lead auditee and serves as escort during inspections and audits performed by external regulatory bodies and internal auditors.
* Execute miscellaneous tasks, as assigned.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* BS or BA in Business Administration/Computer Sciences/Engineering or related degree
* Experience in a leadership position with direct supervision of Quality/Regulatory professionals
* Minimum 8 years’ experience working in a medically regulated industry in a Quality or Regulatory position.
* Experience with ISO13485, MDSAP, MDR, CFR820
* Experience with Project Management, Problem Solving, Six Sigma, Lean Management Systems, Root Cause Analysis, and other standard Quality tools
* Strong project management skills and attention to detail
* Excellent communication skills, cross department collaboration and leadership skills

**Why Laborie:**

Our Mission every day is to operate as a world-class specialist medical company making and advancing technologies that preserve and restore human dignity. We do that today by helping people with pelvic and gastrointestinal conditions live normal lives, and by helping mothers and babies have safe deliveries.

* Paid time off and paid volunteer time
* Medical, Dental, Vision and Flexible Spending Account
* Health Savings Account with Company Funded Contributions
* 401k Retirement Plan with Company Match
* Parental Leave and Adoption Services
* Health and Wellness Programs and Events

We are interested in a qualified candidate who is eligible to work in the United States. However, we will not be sponsoring work visas for this position, at this time.

*Laborie* *provides equal employment opportunities and non-discrimination for all employees and qualified applicants without regard to a person’s race, color, gender, age, religion, national origin, ancestry, disability, veteran status, genetic information, sexual orientation, or any characteristic protected under applicable law. Laborie is committed to providing access and reasonable accommodation in our services, activities, education, and employment for individuals with disabilities.*

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.
